tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba kun gzhi'i ngos 'dzin dang rnam shes dang ye shes 'byed tshul bstan pa legs bshad lha yi rnga chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag byas nas/ /rgyud gsum lam gyi dka' ba'i gnad 'ga' zhig /dpyad gsum dag pa'i ngag gis mdo tsam dbye/ /de la 'dir gang bshad par bya ba ni/ /'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga nas/ khyod kyis kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin gsal kha can rnam shes ye shes kyi dbye ba dang bcas pa/ zhib cha can zhig bri dgos so zhes yang yang bka' stsal yang bri bar ma spobs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ka ma la shī las bsgom rim bar pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'di rgyu med pa las mi 'byung / rgyu nor ba las mi 'byung / rgyu ma tshang ba las mi 'byung bas 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rgyu dang rkyen de dag gang zhe na/ smras pa/ bdag lta bu dmus long dang 'dra bas de dag bstan par mi nus mod kyi/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' nyid kyis bshad do zhes khengs pa bskyungs par mdzad na/ bdag lta bu 'chi ba mi rtag pa rgyun du dran pa'i mngon rtogs tsam yang rgyud la ma skyes pa'i gang zag zhig gis zab pa'i chos 'di dag gi gnad 'chad par mi nus snyam pa yin na yang / da lan yang bka' stsal byung bas/ bla ma'i bka' bcag na ma 'ongs pa'i rten 'brel la gnod snyam pa dang / rang gi go yul la bla mas zhu dag mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pas da ni spobs pa bskyed de cung zad bri bar bya'o/ /de la yid ches pa'i don du thog mar rgyud dang bla ma gong ma'i gsung gi lung khungs rnams 'bri ba dang / de dag gi dgongs don la dpyad de rang lugs gzhag pa dang / de dang mi mthun pa'i lugs gsar pa gzhan la dogs pa dpyad pa gsum las/

dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib/ /zhes dang / dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /lha dang lha min mi rnams dang / /bshang ba'i srin bu la sogs pa/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyis kyang / /bde ba gang phyir mi shes pa/ /rtag tu rang bzhin bde ba can/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgyu rgyud ston byed yin par gsungs la/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa chen pos rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud ces pa'i tshig nyung la don rgyas pa 'di gsungs shing / de'i dgongs don dpal sa skya pa brtse ba chen pos yi ger bkod pa gzhung bshad gnyags ma las/ kun gzhi zhes bya ba ni thabs kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa'i bye brag gis 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i gzhir gyur pas so/ /rgyu ni 'bras bu skye rung gi nus pa'i mthu la bya/ rgyud ni sems can nas rang rig pa'i phreng ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar du sems nyid rig pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ /'khor 'das tshang ba ni/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad mtshan nyid kyi tshul du tshang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam thams cad yon tan gyi tshul du tshang / 'bras bu'i chos thams cad nus mthu'i tshul du tshang ngo / /zhes dang / gzhung bshad sras don ma las gnyags ma las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin dang / gang zag gcig gi sems kyi rgyun sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du rgyun chags su skye bar bstan pa'i phyir/ rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam ni/ zhes sems gsal rig 'di'i steng du rgyud gsum ka 'jog dgos par gsungs la/ 'khor 'das tshang tshul gyi skabs su/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi dang / brten pa kun gzhi nyid rig pa gsal ba phyogs ris su ma chad pa/ gzugs la sogs pa gang ltar yang snang la rang gi ngo bo myong ba ma 'gags pa ste/ zhes dang / sems kyi mtshan nyid rnam rtog yin la/ rnam rtog gi 'bras bu sdug bsngal sna tshogs su myong ste/

tha mal pa'i dus na sems tsha grang gi sdug bsngal du myong tsam na dmyal ba tshang / bkres skom du myong tsam na yi dwags/ blun zhing rmongs par myong tsam na byol song dang / khong khro skyes tsam na lha ma yin/ dga' bde myong tsam na lha/ chos brgyad kyi bya ba la lhag par 'jug cing chags tsam na mi tshang la zhes 'khor ba'i chos mtshan nyid kyi tshul gyis tshang tshul dang / lam dang 'bras bu yon tan dang nus pa'i tshul gyis tshang tshul/ mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gi tshul du tshang tshul zhib tu gsungs mod thams cad 'bri bar ma nus so/ /sa chen gyi dgongs pa kun gzhi'i yig chung du rje btsun gyis bkral ba ni/ don tshan bdun du phye ste/ rten gang yin pa/ brten pa kun gzhi nyid gang yin pa/ rten de la tshul ji ltar brten pa/ rten dang brten pa'i 'brel tshul/ de rgyu rgyud du bzhag pa'i tshul/ de rtsa rgyud du gtan la dbab pa/ de la 'khor 'das kyi chos tshang tshul brtsi ba'o/ /zhes sa bcad mdzad nas/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi sogs zhib tu gsungs nas/ brten pa kun gzhi nyid sems myong rig bye brag tu ma phye ba/ ris sam phyogs su ma chad pa/ thabs rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid la kun gzhi zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / rten la brten tshul me tog dang me tog gi dri ltar grub bde gcig pa ste tha dad med pa'o/ /zhes dang / rten dang brten pa'i 'brel tshul sems la bag chags bsags tshad lus la smin la/ lus la smin tshad phyi rol na yod do/ /zhes dang / kun gzhi nyid phyi rol yul gyi zhen pa la brten nas chags sdang skye bas rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'byung tshul dang / rgyu rgyud du 'jog tshul/ rtsa rgyud du 'jog tshul dang / 'khor 'das tshang tshul rten brten pa gnyis ka la zhib tu gsungs shing / sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gi tshul du tshang ngo /

/zhes gsungs so/ /dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs kyi zhal snga nas/ rgyu rgyud ni sems can thams cad la chos nyid rang bzhin gyis dag pa mya ngan las 'das pa ji ltar yin pa'i tshul dang / de chos can rgyas par phye na phung po khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos sum cu rtsa lnga'am mdor na lus ngag yid gsum ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams so/ /zhes dang / lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba las/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ni ma dag pa lus la sogs pa ste/ zhes dang / ljon shing chen mor/ rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos pa bzhi'i sgo nas rgyu rgyud gtan la 'bebs par mdzad la/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos rgyud gsum gnod 'joms kyi 'grel par gsungs pa ni 'og tu 'chad cing / de'i dngos slob kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i zhal snga nas/ 'o na kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi don gang zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rgyan stug po bkod pa dang / lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo la sogs pa mdo sde du mar/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa zhes mang du gsungs pa'i don la sems tsam pa rnams/ rnam shes tshogs bdun las don gzhan du gyur pa'i shes pa bden par grub pa bag chags bden grub bsgo ba'i gzhir gyur pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam byang gi chos kun gyi rgyur gyur pa/ sa bon gyi cha nyan thos dgra bcom nas ldog kyang / rnam smin gyi cha sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar la rgyun ma chad par yod pa zhig la 'chad kyang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed pas sems myong rig bye brag tu ma phye ba/ ris sam phyogs su ma lhung ba/ thabs rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid la kun gzhi'i sgras bstan par gsungs so/ /de'i don thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar la rgyun ma chad pa'i sems gsal ba tsam 'di nyid gnas skabs su rkyen dbang gis dge mi dge dang / rnam shes tshogs bdun dang /

sems sems byung gi chos du mar 'gyur yang / de dag gi sgo nas mi 'jog par gsal tsam rgyun ma chad pa'i sgo nas 'jog pas na ris sam phyogs su ma lhung ba/ sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du gsal tsam rgyun ma chad par yod pas na thabs rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ de'i ngo bo la dpyad na/ mtha' bzhi'i spros pas stong pas na ngo bo stong pa nyid do/ /des na sems tsam pas bden par grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhir rung bar 'dod cing / 'dir ni/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba nyid/ /gang la stong nyid mi rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba min/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis bden pas stong pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bya byed rung bar bshad pa ni khyad par ro/ /klu sgrub yab sras kyang don 'di nyid bzhed de/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ dper na khab len mthong ba na/ /lcags ni myur du yongs su 'gul/ /'di la sems yod min na yang / /sems dang bcas pa bzhin du snang / /de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam par shes/ /sems med sems dang bcas pa bzhin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba rnam g.yo zhing / /rtag tu srid pa gsum po len/ /dper na rgya mtsho'i mtha' ma las/ /nges par rlabs ni rnam par g.yo/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam par shes/ /lus la brten te g.yo bar byed/ /ces kun gzhi gsungs shing / zla bas 'jug 'grel du/ dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir stong pa nyid kho na kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i sgras bstan par rig par bya'o/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa 'ba' zhig yod par ma zad kyi gang zag kyang yod de/ des 'dul ba'i skye bo la de yod pa nyid du bstan pas rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhi'i skabs su kun gzhi khas len pas sems tsam pa yin zhes pa dang / dbu ma thal 'gyur bas kun gzhi tha snyad du yang khas mi len zhes smra ba ni gsung rab gong 'og gi bab dang grub mtha'i rnam dbye ma phyed pa'o/

/rje btsun gong mas 'di dang chos dbyings kyi sgra don 'dra bar bshad de/ chos ni 'khor ba'i chos phung khams skye mched dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos stobs la sogs pa yin la/ dbyings ni dha tu zhes pa rgyu ste/ de yang sa bon myu gu'i rgyu yin pa ltar skyed byed kyi rgyu ma yin gyi/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rgyu yin pas dbyings su bsgyur ba ste/ thabs kyis ma zin na 'khor ba'i chos kyi rgyu byed/ thabs kyis zin na myang 'das kyi chos kyi rgyu byed par dag ldan las gsungs so/ /'on kyang kun gzhir 'jog pa ni gsal ba'i cha nas 'jog pa gtso che zhing / chos dbyings su 'jog pa ni stong pa'i cha nas 'jog pa gtso che la/ ngo bo zung 'jug yin pa la ni khyad par med do/ rgyu rgyud du 'jog pa sogs ni kun gzhi'i yig chung bzhin shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang rje mus pa chen po rnam gnyis kyi drung du gsung ngag lam 'bras tshar bdun gsan par gsungs pas/ rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi gsung rgyun yin par yang sems so/ /'di'i brgyud 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gong ma'i dgongs rgyan dang / rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gnyis char du tshig gi brjod tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba ma gtogs don gyi gnad 'di dang mtshungs par gsungs shing / khyad par dgongs rgyan du/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba'i cha la gtso bor kun gzhi dang / rang bzhin stong pa'i cha la gshegs snying du bzhed de/ snga mas bag chags bsgo ba'i gzhi dang / phyi mas glo bur gyi dri ma'i rten byed pa'i cha nas bzhag cing / ngo bo zung 'jug yin pa la khyad par med do zhes gsungs so/ /lam 'bras slob bshad rje mus pa chen pos snyan brgyud kyi tshul du bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan la gdams shing / des rje btsun kun spangs chen po la gsungs/ des tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho la gdams pa rnams/

thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse dbang phyug gis zin bris mdzad pa'i khrid yig chen mo'i dgongs pa'ang gong gi gzhung 'di dag dang shin tu mthun te/ khrid yig nyid la gzigs pas gsal lo/ /rje klu sgrub rgya mtshos/ khrid yig tu/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyid la ngos 'dzin mdzad pa 'di ni/ thabs rgyud kyi skabs su rgyud gsum bsres nas nyams su len pa'i dus kyi rgyu rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin yin gyi/ rgyud gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i rgyu rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi ngos 'dzin pa ma yin snyam ste/ gal te yin na gong ma'i gsung rab thams cad dang mi 'grigs pa yin no/ khong gi sku tshe'i stod kyi lta ba gzhan stong la zhen che bar gsungs pas de'i shan cung zad phog pa yin nam snyam ste mkhas pa dag gis dpyad par bya'o/ /spyir khong slob bshad bstan pa'i shing rta chen po yin pas khrid yig gi dbu zhabs kyi don gzhan ni blang bar bya ba kho na yin no/ /kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi steng du 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba bsgom dgos pas de ston byed rtsa rgyud kyi lung / 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /'khor ba gzugs dang sgra la sogs/ /'khor ba tshor ba la sogs pa/ /'khor ba dbang po rnams nyid de/ /'khor ba zhe sdang la sogs pa/ /'di rnams chos ni mya ngan 'das/ /rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas ni/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par gyur/ /byang chub sems ni mya ngan 'das/ /kun rdzob don dam tshul can no/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di thabs rgyud kyi lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ston byed yin mod/ 'di'i tshig zur gyi 'khor ba'i chos thams cad rgyu rgyud du go dgos te/ rgyud gsum bsres nas nyams su len dus kyi rgyu rgyud kyi ldog pa yin pa'i phyir/

gong ma'i gsung rab gzhan dang / gzhung bshad man ngag gter mdzod sogs kyi lung khungs ni re zhig bzhag go /gnyis pa de dag gi dgongs don la dpyad de rang lugs gzhag pa ni/ spyir sngags lam gyi nyams len thams cad kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ lus thabs rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum du bsdus nas ston pa'i skabs kyi kun gzhi rgyu rgyud yin na/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi brten pa kun gzhi dang bcas pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad kun gzhi rgyu rgyud yin pa'i go ba len shes dgos te/ rje btsun gyis/ jo lcags mar/ gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnas tshul/ lam ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa bshad pa gsum las/ dang po 'dir mi 'chad de/ ma dag pa'i snang ba'i skabs su bstan zin to zhes gsungs pa'i dang po kun gzhi rgyu rgyud yin te/ rgyud gsum gyis sa bcad pa'i dang po yin pa'i phyir/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud ces pa'i rdo rje'i tshig 'di gting zab cing rgya che ba zhig yin pas 'di'i go don tshul bzhin du slong ma shes na/ sa skya pa'i kun gzhi 'dod pa 'di sems tsam pa dang 'dra zhes dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kho na kun gzhi yin zhes sogs sgro skur byed pa ni sngon gyi dus nas byung bar 'dug go /sems kun gzhi'i gsal cha de bag chags kyi rten du bzhed pa sems tsam pa dang 'dra yang / ngo bo stong pa la bya byed rung bar gsungs pa dang 'khor 'das tshang tshul sogs gsungs pa mi 'dra bas/ ngor chen gyis/ sems tsam pa'i kun gzhi dang mi 'dra gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'ang de yin no/ /'jam mgon bdag nyid chen pos/ phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su gsungs/ /zhes pa'i phung khams skye mched kyang kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du ngos 'dzin dgos so/

/ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi yi 'dzin ma la/ /rnam dkar dbang bzhi'i char rgyun legs phab pas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi yang rgyu rgyud yin la/ zla zer du/ gzhi yi gnas lugs skye 'chi bar do gsum/ /ji ltar yod bzhin nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /'bras bu sku gsum mngon du byed pa yi/ /shing rta chen po'i lam 'di kho bos rtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum yang rgyu rgyud du bsdu dgos so/ /ljon shing gi rigs dang rigs bdag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis grol bar 'thad pa 'chad pa'i skabs su/ rgyu 'khor ba'i chos thams cad 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yin tshul gsungs pa'ang gnad 'di dang gcig pa yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi gtso bor smos pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad rang sems skad cig ma'i cho 'phrul du ngo shes pa'i/ sems myong rig bye brag tu ma phye ba/ ris sam phyogs su ma chad pa/ thabs rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid la kun gzhir bzhed pa yin pas/ rgyas bshad du/ kun gzhi'i rang bzhin dang / rten dang / brten tshul/ rgyu dang / rtsa ba dang / 'brel tshul/ 'khor 'das tshang tshul te bdun gyi sgo nas bkral dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /des na rgyu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos nyer bdun po thams cad kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du khas len dgos kyi lhan skyes kyi ye shes kho na kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du khas len pa gzhung dang mi 'grigs te/ lhan skyes kyi ye shes bsgom pa'i tshe/ gzhi gang du bsgom pa/ ngo bo gang bsgom pa sogs kyis sa bcad nas kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi steng du 'khor 'das dbyer med bsgom dgos par gsungs kyi/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud rang ldog nas lhan skyes kyi ye shes yin par ma gsungs so/ /'o na khyed kyis sems 'khrul pa dang bcas pa la kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du ngos 'dzin par 'dug pas/

khyed kyi lam 'di mi zab pa yin no zhe na/ sems 'khrul pa dang bcas pa la kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du ngos bzung nas/ thabs rgyud kyis ma zin par 'jog na khyed bden mod/ de 'dra ma yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ gang dang gang gis 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba/ /de dang des ni 'ching ba las grol te/ /de nyid mi shes 'jig rten mi grol zhing / /de nyid rnam spangs dngos grub rnyed mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa 'dag /ces dang / grub chen sa ra has/ gang gis blun po 'ching ba'i dngos/ /de yis mkhas rnams rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khrul snang la lam du byas kyang thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i stobs kyis dus myur ba nyid du 'khrul snang ye shes su mthong nas grol bar 'gyur ba yin pas lam 'di ches zab pa yin zhing / des na lam 'di la rnam shes dang ye shes kyi dbye ba dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /gal te cis kyang dang po nyid nas ma 'khrul ba lam du byed dgos so zhe na/ gang zag dbang po yang rab rig pa rang snang gi blo can rnams la bla ma rtogs ldan gyis rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo sprod mdzad de ngo 'phrod pa'i tshe de 'dra 'byung srid mod/ de man chad la bla ma rong ston lha dgas rje btsun mi la la ngo sprod btab pa lta bu zhig red 'gro nyen che bas rang gi rgyud tshod dang bstun pa'i chos nyams su len pa ni gnad du che ste/ gang zag dman pas chos la mtho bsnyabs byas te mgo mtho sar btags nas ske dma' sa nas chad pa 'ga' re mthong ngo / /'o na khyed kyi kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi steng du 'khor 'das dbyer med ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ rje btsun rin po ches/ rang sems gdod nas spros bral rgyu rgyud dang / /dbang gi ye shes lam gyi lta ba dang / /nyams myong sangs rgyas sa dang ngo bo gcig /rtogs pa'i khyad par zla ba'i dpe yis bstan/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems su ngo shes pa'i sems gsal tsam rgyun mi 'chad pa de'i rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du thag chod nas/ sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rgyu rgyud dang / dbang dus kyi ye shes/ lam gyi lta ba/ nyams myong gi ting nge 'dzin/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnams ngo bo gcig tu thag bcad de/ rgyud gsum dbyer med du bsres nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /des na de 'dra'i skabs kyi rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la rgyu rgyud gsungs pa dang / rgyud gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud ces pa'i rgyu rgyud gnyis cung zad ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ba'i gnad kyang shes dgos so/ /des na sa paṇ+ḍi tas rtogs ldan rgyan po pa la gdams pa phyag chen mig thur du/ sems kun gzhi'i kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs nas/ zhes dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ lhan skyes kyi chos gsum la gnas tshul gyi dbang du byas pa dang / snang tshul gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis gsungs pa 'di dag la dpags na/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'chad pa'i tshe kun rdzob dang don dam gyi cha gnyis yod kyang / bsgom pa'i tshe bden gnyis ya bral du ma shor ba zhig gnad du che bar sems so/ /kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang tshul gyi gnad dang / lus thabs rgyud kyi tshe spang bya lus kyis spong / gnyen po lus kyis byed/ sa lam lus kyi steng du bgrod par gsungs pa'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad dang / rgyud gsum gyis bkri tshul 'di dang / gnad drug gi sgo nas bkri ba gnyis ngo bo mtshungs pas rgyu la gnas pa/ dbang las thob pa/ lam la goms pa/ lta ba la nyams su myong ba/ grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba/ 'bras bu la mngon du gyur pa rnams kyi gnad la nges pa skyes tshe/

'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras sdug kun gnyis myang 'das kyi rgyu 'bras 'gog lam gnyis su gnas 'gyur bar go nas sdug bsngal bden pa skur mthong nas 'gog bden dang / kun 'byung bden pa ye shes su mthong nas lam bden du rtogs te lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don la yid ches skye bar 'gyur ba yin la/ de'i dus su bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba yang / blos btags kyi mtshon chos bsgrigs pa tsam ma yin par/ rgyu rgyud kyi dag pa gsum/ thabs rgyud dang 'bras rgyud kyi dag pa gsum du ngo 'phrod nas snying nas yid ches skye zhing / lus dkyil sgom pa'i tshe'ang gdod nas sku dang ye shes yin pa la yin par ngo shes par 'dug pas ye shes pa gzhug ga la dgos snyam pa dang / gya nom lhar zhen gyi dri mas gtan nas ma gos pa zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /lus thabs rgyud kyi skabs su/ ches zab pa'i chos 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i tshe smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis dang / de'i yan lag gtor ma/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa thams cad kyi dus su rgyud gsum bsres nas/ rgyu 'bras rgyas gdab gnyis/ lus sems rgyas gdab gnyis/ ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgya ste rgya lnga'i rwa bar btsud de sgom par byed pa yin pas/ rang rang gi thad so'i rgyu lam 'bras gsum gyi ldog cha so sor shes par byas te gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len pas na bdag nyid chen pos/ brda don gsal ba'i khrid yig gi bar skabs tshigs bcad/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med don smra ba/ /'khon gyi rigs skyes shākya'i sras po mchog /rdo rje'i rigs can kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po las gzhan don mthun smra ba su/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud mthar thug gnas 'gyur 'chad pa'i tshe'ang / ljon shing las/ phung po lnga rigs lngar/

dug lnga ye shes lngar/ dkyil 'khor bzhi sku bzhir/ lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs su gnas 'gyur bar gsungs pa de kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi gnas 'gyur tshul gsungs pa yin pas phung po lnga/ dug lnga/ dkyil 'khor bzhi/ lus ngag yid gsum/ rnam shes brgyad rnams sems myong rig bye brag tu ma phye ba/ ris sam phyogs su ma lhung ba/ thabs rig pa gsal la ma 'gag pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid la kun gzhir bzhed pa yin gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid 'dis khyab dgos pa'i gnad kyang shes dgos te/ ljon shing las/ ngo bo gcig kyang ldog pa tha dad pa rnam pa bzhi ste/ phung po lngar bsdus pa dang / dkyil 'khor bzhi rten yin la brten pa yid dang lngar bsdus pa dang / lus ngag yid gsum du bsdus pa dang / de dag thams cad kyi byed pa po yin pa'i phyir yid 'ba' zhig gnas 'gyur tshul lo/ /zhes de thams cad ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad du gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar gnas 'gyur bshad pa de'ang kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi kun rdzob kyi cha yin gyi/ don dam ma yin pas/ rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kho na rgyu rgyud du khas blangs na gnas 'gyur mi 'thad de/ rang bzhin la gnas 'gyur rang lugs la mi bzhed pa'i phyir dang / rgyud gsum du dbye ba 'di kun rdzob thabs kyi cha gtso bo yin par rab dbye las/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi/ /dbye ba thams cad kun rdzob yin/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /dbang bskur la sogs cho ga dang / /bsgom pa'i dmigs pa ji snyed dang / /rten 'brel zab mo thams cad dang / /sa dang lam gyi dbye ba dang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa yang / /kun rdzob yin gyi don dam min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di dag gi gnad la dgag sgrub cung zad ma byas na don gyi go ba bskyed mi nus la/ byas na rang gi rgyud tshod dman pa rang nyid kyi mngon sum tshad mas grub pas sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa sar gnas kyi byang sems yin nges snyam pa'i gsung la zur za zhus pa rkang zhabs kyi rdul 'phags nas dpral ba'i mig phud zer ba'i dpe ltar du 'gro nyen che'ang /

deng gi skabs su bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di nyid kyi 'dun sa nas/ gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi bstan pa nyi zhur tsam gnas shing / de la rjes su 'jug pa'i skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros gsal ba'i mkhas pa mang po bzhugs pas/ de dag la phan du re nas da ni 'dzem med du smra bar bya ste/ spyir 'jigs bral rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i gsung ngag mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i don gyi bcud phyung ba/ dpal brtse ba chen po yab sras kyi rang lugs/ rgyud gsum nyams len gyi gnad kyi go ba ni/ rgyu rgyud 'khor ba'i chos phung khams skye mched lcags khams lta bu de/ thabs rgyud yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba smin grol gyi lam yan lag dang bcas pa man ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bus bran pa'i tshe/ 'bras rgyud sku dang ye shes phrin las dang bcas pa gser bzang po lta bu'i ngo bor dus myur ba nyid du gnas 'gyur bar byed pa la gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi gdams pa zer ba yin pa la/ 'di'i rgyu rgyud ngos 'dzin gyi skabs su/ rgyu rgyud kyi ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kho na yin gyi sems 'khrul pa'i cha rnams min gsungs pa ni/ dbu ma gzhan stong gi lta ba thugs dbus su bcug pa'i skyon las byung ba la the tshom med de/ gzhan stong pa rnams gsang sngags kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba'i tshe/ phung khams skye mched thams cad la mtshan nyid gsum gsum du phye ba'i yongs grub kho na sbyang gzhi yin gyi/ kun brtags gzhan dbang gnyis kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i cha yin pas sbyang gzhi min te spang bya yin no/ /zhes bzhed pa 'di thugs la bzung nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyu rgyud yin gyi/ sems kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i cha rgyu rgyud min zhes gsung gin 'dug pa'i phyir/ des na gnad kyi go ba 'di ltar nges par bya ste/

bod gangs can gyi ljongs su zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba smra ba snga phyir byung ba rnams kyi bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa las thams cad 'bri bar mi nus mod/ gnad don dbu ma gzhan stong pa rnams chos rnams la mtshan nyid gsum du phye nas kun brtags gzhan dbang gnyis kun rdzob yin pas spang bya dang / yongs grub bde gshegs snying po don dam blang bya yin no/ /zhes bden gnyis gcig grogs su gcig mi 'dod pa zhig dang / rgyal bas lung gis yang yang bsngags pa dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang ldan pa dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs kyis/ tha snyad bden pa thabs su gyur pa dang / /don dam bden pa thabs byung gyur pa ste/ /de gnyis rnam dbye gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni rnam rtog log pa'i lam ngan zhugs/ /zhes dang / kun rdzob de nyid gshog yangs dkar po rgyas gyur pa/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po de ni skye bo ngang pa yi/ /mdun du bdar nas dge ba'i rlung gi shugs stobs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol mchog tu 'gro/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med de/ /de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams/ /de las nyams pas thar pa 'grub yod min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bden gnyis gcig grogs su gcig mthong nas thabs shes zung 'jug gi lam gyis sa lam bgrod pa'i tshul gnyis yod pa las/ rang re rnams phyi ma 'di'i rjes 'jug yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kye yi rdo rje bstan/ /zhes sngags kyi nyams len gyi sngon du dbu ma'i grub mtha' la bslab dgos par gsungs la/ slob tshul rje btsun rin po ches/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gsung dang / dbu ma 'jug pa sogs la bslab par bya'o zhes rjes 'jug rnams la gdams par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/

/dbu ma gzhan stong gi grub mtha' rang lugs ma yin te/ rje btsun rin po ches/ nyan thos dag myang 'das rdzas grub tu 'dod la/ de ltar du da lta bod kyi dbu ma pa phal cher yang 'dod do/ /yang dag pa ma yin te/ sngar yang sun phyung la/ stong min stong pa min pa'ang min/ /zhes bya ba'i skabs su dgag par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'jam mgon bdag nyid chen pos rab dbye las kyang dgag pa mang du mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /sngags rgyud sde'i dgongs pa nyams su len pa la'ang dang po nyid nas rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kho na rtsal du bton te thabs smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam yan lag dang bcas pa la ha cang gtsigs su mi mdzad pa zhig dang / thog mar smin byed kyi dbang zhus/ de nas grol byed kyi lam lta ba dang bskyed rdzogs sogs mchog gi mngon rtogs lnga dang / bzlas brjod sogs yan lag gi mngon rtogs lnga dang / thun mong gi mngon rtogs dam tshig dang sdom pa ste bcu gcig yod pa las/ gang zag dbang po rab la dbang dus su ye shes skye ba'ang yod mod/ 'bring man chad la thabs rgyud kyi mngon rtogs rnams la tshul bzhin du bslabs pas da gzod rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar bzhed nas/ thabs rgyud la shin tu gnad che bar mdzad pa'i lugs gnyis yod pa las/ rang re rnams phyi ma 'di'i brgyud 'dzin yin la/ de'ang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa chen pos/ gsang sngags kyi lam nyams su len pa la rten 'brel gnad du che bar bzhed cing / rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur nas bsgrigs par mdzad la/ de'ang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid mthar thug dang bcas pa'i rten 'brel lnga 'grig dgos pa las/ kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum la/ kun brtags la gzhan dbang gi rgya dang / gzhan dbang la gzhan dbang gi rgya dang / gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyi rgyas btab nas bsgom pa'i tshe kun brtags tha snyad du med kyang gzhan dbang kun rdzob kyi bden pa 'di shin tu gnad che ste/

rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ lus khyad par can la brten nas dngos po'i mtha' rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gzhan dbang rten 'brel zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rten 'brel lnga gzhan dbang kun rdzob bden pa dang / yongs grub stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa'i steng du 'grig dgos pa yin gyi/ yongs grub stong nyid kho na la rtsal du bton na/ rten 'brel lnga'i rnam gzhag thams cad rmang nas 'jig par byed pa yin no/ /der ma zad gzhan stong gi lta ba 'di ji lta ba bzhin khas blangs na/ sa skya pa'i rang lugs kyi lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med gtan nas bsgom mi shes pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud kyi/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'grel pa dag ldan las/ 'di nyid ces bya ba ni/ chos can gyi phyogs thams cad do/ /'khor ba zhes bya ste/ zhes bya ba ni/ las dang nyon mongs pas khams gsum na 'khor lo bzhin du kun tu 'khor ba'i phyir ro/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /ces bya ba ni/ de nyid kyi chos nyid rtogs na sdug bsngal gyi phung po las yongs su grol ba'i phyir mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /des na/ 'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes bya ste/ 'khor ba yang dag par ma grub pa nyid mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba las gnas sa gzhan zhig tu skyas la 'gro sa med de/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba spangs par gyur pa yi/ /mya ngan 'das khyod mi bzhed kyi/ /'khor ba mi dmigs pa yi ni/ /zhi nyid mgon po khyod kyis bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du de'i rgyas bshad dbang po phung po nyon mongs rnams la mdor bstan gyi 'di nyid ces pa'i nges bzung gi sgra dang / 'khor ba spangs par gyur pa yi/ /zhes sogs sbyar nas bshad shes tshe 'khor 'das blang dor du 'dzin pa la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba mi 'byung ba go ste/

gzhan stong pa rnams kyis/ kun brtags gzhan dbang gnyis glo bur gyi dri ma kun rdzob 'khrul pa spang bya yin pas lam du byas kyang 'bras bur mi 'gyur bas spang bya kho na yin no zhes dang / yongs grub bde gshegs snying po don dam mya ngan las 'das pa blang bya yin la/ de gsar du bskyed mi dgos par gdod nas grub pa yin no zhes bzhed la/ de lta bu'i 'khor 'das gnyis dbyer med du ji ltar bsgom legs par soms dang / dper na mi gnyis kyis gcig gis kha shar dang gcig gis kha nub tu bltas te skad cig kyang mi sdod par song na de gnyis 'phrad pa'i dus mi 'byung ba dang 'dra ba yin no/ /'di la ni gangs can gyi mkhas pa kun 'dus nas bka' bgros kyang bdag la lan med do/ /yang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bsgom pa'i skabs su/ sems dwangs snyigs 'byed pa 'di'ang / snyigs ma zhes pa kun brtags dang gzhan dbang gnyis la thugs rtse gtad/ dwangs ma zhes pa yongs grub la thugs rtse gtad nas gsungs pa yin na ni/ gzhung 'di dang gtan nas mi 'grigs te/ gong gi klu sgrub kyi lung 'don pa bsgyur te/ snyigs ma spangs par gyur pa yi/ /dwangs ma'i ye shes khyod mi bzhed/ /snyigs ma mi dmigs pa nyid kyi/ /ye shes mgon po khyod kyis bstan/ /zhes bton na lan ji skad gsungs/ de 'dra ma yin par snyigs ma zhes pa go yul gyi lta ba dang / dwangs ma zhes pa nyams myong gi ting nge 'dzin la bzhed pa yin na ni/ rje btsun chen pos/ drod chung ngu'i rtogs pa 'chad pa'i tshe/ dag ldan du/ 'jig rten chos brgyad la dgos pa med do zhes shes pa tsam ma yin par/ rang gi nyams myong gi ting nge 'dzin la thams cad mnyam pa nyid du 'char na drod chung ngu thob pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang gnad gcig par 'dug pas shin tu legs par bshad pa'i chos su go nas dang po nyid nas skyabs su 'gro ba yin no/ /des na gzhan stong gi bzhed tshul 'di sa skya pa'i lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med bsgom pa dang /

bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba la gtan nas mi 'grigs pas/ paṇa chen shāka mchog gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad rnams kyis rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa nyams su len pa la gnod par dgongs nas/ kun mkhyen chen pos man ngag rnam bshad kyi mjug dang / sdom gsum kha skong sogs su dgag gzhag mang du mdzad pa dang / glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub pas kyang sa skya pa'i bstan pa nyams pa thugs kyis ma bzod nas/ sgo rum mgon khang du mgon po yid bzhin nor bu dpang por bzhag nas zhib mo rnam 'thag kha skong dang bcas pa/ paṇa chen gyi grub mtha' dgag pa'i phyir mdzad par gsungs pas legs bshad de dag la zhib tu gzigs na rang lugs la nges pa rnyed cing / bdag gis smras pa'i tshig 'di dag gi rgyab rten du'ang 'gyur ba yin no/ /'o na khyod gzhan stong gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i dol po ba shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs la dad pa med pa yin nam zhe na/ khong o rgyan rin po che'i sprul par dol po pa rang nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes shing / paṇa chen shāka mchog kyang mkhas grub kyi skyes bu chen po yin pas/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ bdag ni dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ /brgyud 'dzin nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i/ /skyes chen brgyud pa 'di dag la/ /yid ni shin tu dad mod kyi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems la dad pa yod kyang rang lugs kyi nyams len gyi gnad 'chad pa'i tshe de dang mi mthun pa rnams la dgag pa'i khur cung zad blang ba ni/ gal te de nyid rnam par bshad pa na/ /gzhan gzhung 'jig par gyur na nyes pa med/ /ces gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs pa yin no/ /'khrul pa'i cha rnams rgyu rgyud du khas ma blangs par rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kho na rgyu rgyud du khas blangs na/ lam tshogs sbyor gnyis mthong lam dang bcas pa dang / bsgom lam sa bcu gnyis kyi bar du bgrod de rgyu rgyud kyi phung khams skye mched rnams 'bras rgyud du gnas 'gyur ba'i tshe/

rang nyid kyi gzhan dbang kun rdzob 'khor ba'i cha rnams rgyu rgyud ngos 'dzin gyi dus nas spangs zin pas rang nyid la gnas 'gyur rgyu med pas/ gang zag gzhan zhig la/ khyod kyi phung po lnga/ nyon mongs lnga/ dkyil 'khor bzhi/ lus ngag yid gsum/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad rnams nga la g.yar rogs zer dgos pa 'byung ba yin no/ /'o na khyod kyi gzhan dbang 'khor ba'i cha rnams ma spangs par lam du byas nas ye shes su gnas 'gyur tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'di'i gzhung bshad rnams su sgrib gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun chags la nyon sgrib dang nyams skyon can brgyad la shes sgrib tu mdzad pa de nyon mongs dug lnga chos 'di'i lugs kyi kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du song ba'i gnad kas yin pas/ nyon mongs pa ye shes su gnas 'gyur tshul/ brtag pa dang po'i le'u brgyad pa'i/ 'dod chags zhe sdang phrag dog dang / /de bzhin gti mug nga rgyal nyid/ /de kun de gnas nyams dga' bar/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes pa'i 'grel pa dag ldan las rje btsun chen pos 'di ltar gsungs te/ de la de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i tshe/ spang bya nyon mongs pa rnams ji ltar gnas zhe na/ spyir nyon mongs pa dang / de'i rgyu rnam par rtog pa dang / ye shes chen po rnams kyang rang gi sems kyi chos nyid las gzhan du grub pa med do/ /des na thog mar nyon mongs pa rags pa ye shes phra mos 'joms pa'i tshe yang nyon mongs pa nyid kyi cha ye shes nyid du go bas 'joms pa yin la/ mthar nyon mongs pa chung ngu ye shes chen pos 'joms pa'i tshe yang nyon mongs pa nyid ye shes su gnas gyur pa yin no/ /de'ang gnas gyur pa'i tshul ni/ 'dod chags ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ zhe sdang ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gti mug ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ phrag dog ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nga rgyal ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/

/kha cig gnas gyur pa 'di ni mi rigs te/ skad cig gong ma gnas ma gyur pa de ni phyi mar 'ongs pa med la/ phyi ma ni ye shes nyid yin pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ba ni/ chos nyid la dgongs pa yin la yon tan thob pa la dmigs na gnas gyur cis kyang 'byung ste/ 'phags pas kyang chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las/ /gnas ni yongs su gyur pa ste/ /chos kyi sku zhes bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rim gyis je gsal je gsal ye shes chen por 'gyur ba yin te/ lcags kyi gong bu rab tu bsregs pas me'i phung por gyur pa lta bu'o/ /des na nyon mongs pa spangs kyang dri ma logs su dor bar bya rgyu ni med de/ de kun de gnas zhes bya'o/ /'o na nyon mongs pa de dag gseb na sbas pa lta bur yod dam zhe na/ de'ang med de/ nyams dga' bar/ zhes bya ba ste nyon mongs pa nyid ye shes su gyur/ ces bya ba'i don yin no/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod/ /ces bya ba ni/ bsgrun par mi bzod cing char yang brtsi bar byar med pa la bcu drug cha zhes 'jig rten pa dang sgra pa'i lugs la grags te/ cha phra mo zhig da dung yod do zhes bya ba lta bu ni ma yin no/ /des na nyon mongs pa spangs pa dang ye shes thob pa'i gnas skabs 'di'ang snang ba dang mun pa'am/ srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin te/ spang bya cung zad yod pa'i tshe'ang thob bya'i chas ma gang la/ ye shes thams cad rdzogs pa'i tshe spang bya gtan nas med pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di dag ldan gyi tshig zur tsam yang ma nyams par bris pa yin pas sa skya'i rjes 'jug kun gyis yid ches pa'i gnas yin no/ /de bzhin du rnam rtog ye shes su 'char tshul/ dpal brtse ba chen pos/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi 'grel par/ lus ngag yid gsum ye shes dang sku bzhir byin gyis rlobs pa'i rten 'brel sgrig mkhyen pa zhig las dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba 'thob dgos/

de nas thog mar lta ba bsgoms la/ de'i ye shes cung zad skyes pa na/ rnam par rtog pa'i ye shes kyi/ /dbang du gyur na 'khor ba med/ /ye shes rnam par rtog pa yi/ /dbang du gyur na grol ba med/ /rnam rtog chos nyid kyi dbang du gyur na 'khor ba'i snang ba med de/ chab rom chur zhu ba bzhin no/ /chos nyid rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du gyur na grol ba mi srid de/ chu 'khyags pa chab rom du gyur na chu'i bya ba mi nus pa bzhin no/ /zhes dang / nyon mongs lnga po bskyed rim gyi dbang du gyur na rigs lnga'i snang ba 'char/ zhes dang / rnam rtog chos nyid kyi dbang du byas pa bzhin du snang ba bskyed rim gyi dbang du byas na/ gdon dang nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi snang bar shar nas byin rlabs 'byung zhes gsungs pa ni lung khungs mdo tsam bris pa yin la/ de'i don nyams su len pa'i tshe/ chos can gsal ba la thabs kun rdzob 'khor ba dang / de'i rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub pa'i chos nyid stong pa la shes rab don dam pa myang 'das su byas nas/ bden gnyis zung 'jug gi tshul du 'khor 'das dbyer med sgom pa zhig dang / sbyang gzhi la 'khor ba/ sbyong byed la myang 'das su byas nas/ 'khor 'das dbyer med sgom tshul gnyis gtso che ba las/ dang po la go ba dpyis phyin pa zhig byung tshe/ rang rgyud la rnam rtog skye bzhin pa'i dus na/ rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i nges pa rnyed nas/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gang shar thams cad mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes su 'char ba zhig 'byung bar gsungs so/ /de'ang bdag nyid chen pos/ chos kun gdod nas skye ba med/ /skyes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa/ /skye med nyid kyang skye bar ston/ /des na skye dang ma skyes dang / /rtog pa dang ni rtog med dang / /snang ba dang ni stong pa dang / /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yang / /dam pa'i don la dbye ba med/

/ces gsungs pa lta bu yin no/ /phyi ma sbyang gzhi sbyong byed la 'khor 'das dbyer med du sgom pa'i tshe/ dper na gzugs phung rnam snang du sgom pa lta ba la sbyar te bshad na gzugs phung zhes pa sems las logs su grub par lugs 'di la mi bzhed pas sems gsal zhing rig pa 'di nyid yin pas sngar gzugs phung rnam snang du ma shes pa la da bla ma'i drin gyis gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du sgom pa'i tshe/ rgyu 'bras rgyas gdab kyi gnad legs par rtogs na sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod par 'gyur la/ lus sems rgyas gdab kyi gnad legs par rtogs tshe tha na'ang go yul tsam du snang sems 'dres nas gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas mi gos pa zhig 'byung la/ de thams cad la ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgyas thebs tshe lha sku snang tsam po de nyid chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang las mi g.yo ba zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /des na chos can 'khor ba/ chos nyid la myang 'das su byas nas 'khor 'das dbyer med sgom yang rung / sbyang gzhi la 'khor ba/ sbyong byed la myang 'das su byas nas 'khor 'das dbyer med sgom yang rung / sngar 'khor 'das dbyer med du rmongs pa'i dbang gis ma shes pa la/ da legs par rtogs pas ngo shes ma shes kyi ldog cha tsam los yod ma gtogs/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyi cha spangs nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa rtogs pa lta bu la go na 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi gnad ma zin pa yin no/ /des na phar phyin theg pa'i gzhi dbu ma bden gnyis zung 'jug gi skabs su/ bdag nyid chen pos/ kun rdzob legs par rtogs tsam na/ /don dam logs su lus pa med/ /ces bden gnyis gcig grogs su gcig 'gro bar go dgos par gsungs pa ltar lam dbu ma tshogs gnyis zung 'jug dang / 'bras bu dbu ma sku gnyis zung 'jug la'ang gnad de bzhin shes dgos pa ltar/ lugs 'di la'ang rgyu rgyud 'khor 'das dbyer med du gdod nas gnas pa de thabs rgyud 'khor 'das dbyer med du shes pa'i lam gyis sbyangs pas 'bras rgyud sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa lhun grub gnas 'gyur gyi tshul du mngon du byed pa yin la/

de'ang phar phyin theg pas gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med du ma shes pas dus bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs pa'i bar du tshogs gsag dgos la/ rdo rje theg pas gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med du ngo shes nas sgom pas myur du tshe gcig la sogs pas 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ /de bzhin du lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes su sgom pa dang snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su sgom pa'i tshe sngar ngo ma shes pa la da shes pa lta bu'i cha los yod ma gtogs/ lha sngags ye shes ma yin pa'i cha dang / dag pa rab 'byams ma yin pa'i cha logs su spang rgyu yod pa lta bu la go mi rung zhing / rnal 'byor pa la 'dre gzugs snang ba'i tshe/ rang gi 'dre 'dzin gyi rnam rtog las logs na 'dre med par shes nas lam du khyer ba las/ spang rgyu'i 'dre dang blang rgyu'i 'dre gnyis su dbye mi dgos pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad ngo shes na mya ngan las 'das par go ba las/ 'khor ba'i chos kyi nang na spang blang gnyis yod pa lta bur gtan nas go mi rung ba yin no/ /de la khyod kyis mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i khrid yig la zur za byas pa de mi 'os pa yin no zhe na/ khong la brnyas bcos dang / rang nyid kyi mkhas khyad 'don pa'i phyir bris pa yin na thugs shin tu bden mod/ bla ma khong la ma gus pa med pa ni dkon mchog gi thugs mi khrel bas/ de 'dra ma lags te/ khong gis rgyu rgyud lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kho nar zhal gyis bzhes pa de/ thabs rgyud kyi skabs su bla mas chos thams cad sems su ngo sprad/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ngo sprad de/ rgyud gsum bsres nas nyams su len dus kyi rgyu rgyud lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid rtsal du bton nas gsungs pa yin gyi/ rgyud gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i rgyu rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin mdzad pa ma yin zhes gong ma'i gsung rab rnams dang mthun pa'i phyir khong gi khrid yig gi dgongs pa blangs pa yin no/

/gal te khyod kyis dgongs pa ma lon te/ rgyu rgyud kyi go ba ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kho na la ngos 'dzin dgos so zhe na/ 'o na sa skya pa'i nyams len gyi snying po lam dus kyi nang na/ phung khams skye mched dkyil 'khor bzhi sogs mang po zhig sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar nas gsungs 'dug pas/ 'khor ba'i chos 'di rnams kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi nang du ni mi 'du la/ lus thabs rgyud ni ma yin te/ sems can thams cad 'bad med du grol bar thal ba'i phyir ro/ /phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ni de bas kyang ma yin pas/ 'di rnams rgyud gsum po gang gi nang du bsdu/ yang phung khams skye mched 'di rnams sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar nas sgom pa la dgos pa ci yod ces khyod nyid la dri bar bya'o/ /de la 'di skad du/ 'di rnams sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar te bsgoms na/ nam zhig na sku dang ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba yin no zhe na/ 'di rnams rgyu rgyud min pa'i dam bca' nyams te/ rgyu rgyud kyi go ba de 'dra zhig la blang dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'on te phung khams skye mched kyi ming gis brjod rung 'di rnams lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin la/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba yin no zhe na/ ngo bo la gnas 'gyur rje btsun gong ma gtan nas mi bzhed cing / bdag gi ngo bo thob zin pa bdag gi bdag nyid du slar skye'o zhes pa dang tshig 'di brjod tshul mtshungs pas mi 'thad pa yin no/ /gal te phung khams skye mched 'di dag 'khrul pa yin pas spang bya yin no zhe na/ rgyud dang rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rnams su 'khor ba nyid ma spangs par lam du byas na myang 'das yin tshul dang / nyon mongs pa nyid ye shes su 'char dgos tshul/ rnam rtog nyid ye shes su gnas 'gyur tshul mang du gsungs pa'i lung rnams dang /

dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs kyis rdo rje theg pas gzhi mi spong bar lam du byed tshul gsungs pa rnams dang 'gal lam mi 'gal gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyod dang / bdag gis zhu mi dgos par 'dug go /des na kho bos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i khrid yig la zhabs tog dang / brgyud 'dzin gyi nyams len la zhu dag gnyis chabs cig la grub par byas pa'i tshig 'di rnams la/ snyan brgyud bzhi ldan gyi bla ma'i zhabs pad dad brgya'i gtsug tu mchod de/ kha zhe mngon lkog med pa'i mos gus kyis gsol 'debs yun ring por byas pa'i lag rjes cung zhig yod par sems pas/ bdag nyid chen pos/ legs bshad byis pa'i ngag las kyang / /mkhas pa rnams ni yongs su len/ /dri zhim byung na ri dwags kyi/ /lte ba las kyang gla rtsi len/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang zag la mi rton chos la rton pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis blang 'os pa yin no/ /rnam shes dang ye shes kyi dbye ba ni/ byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyis mdzad pa 'di las lhag pa sus kyang mi thon pas/ 'di nyid sor bzhag tu bri bar bya ste/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skabs dbye bar mdzad du gsol/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba bsgom zhes gsungs pa'i kun gzhi de nyid lta ba bstan pa'i thog mar ngo sprod pa'i tshe/ de ga lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin zhes yig cha la la nas 'byung ba'i dgongs gzhi ma lon par brten/ da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma 'di nyid ye shes su 'khrul pa 'ga' 'dug pa'i phyir/ ngo bo gcig las ma 'das kyang / ldog pa'i cha nas so sor ma phyes na cung mi 'grig par sems pas des na kun gzhi dang / lhan skyes ye shes rang rkyang gi rnam par dbye ba rang gi sems la go tshul rnams bshad par bya ste/ de la thog mar kun gzhi'i ngos 'dzin tshul la yang mi 'dra bar snang zhing /

kun mkhyen klu sgrub zhabs kyis ni/ brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dri ma med pa de nyid kun gzhir bzhed/ gzhan phal che bas ni da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma rnam rtog gis ma bslad pa 'di nyid kun gzhir bzhed/ phyi ma ji lta bar/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis kyang / de'i ngo bo stong nyid yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'khor 'das kyi bya byed rung bar 'dod pas na/ mtshan gzhi ni mi mthun pa med la/ mtshan nyid mi mthun pa ni dbu sems kyi grub mtha'i khyad par yin no zhes gsungs pa de kho na bzhin kho bo yang 'dod de/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi nang tshan kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa de ga las gzhan du ma yin na yang / de'i ngo bo gang du yang ma grub cing / de la kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du btags/ 'o na de ga lhan skyes kyi ye shes dri ma med pa e yin snyam na/ ma yin te/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba bsgom dgos par gzhung las gsungs shing / ye shes mtshan nyid pa ni lta bsgom gyi rgyun bskyangs pas ji zhig na rtogs pa las/ dang po nyid du rtogs par dka' ba'i phyir/ de la kun gzhir 'dod na lta ba bsgom yang mi shes par 'gyur te/ las dang po pas de mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ gal te rtogs yod na ni lta ba bsgom yang mi dgos te/ lta ba bsgom pa rang yang lhan skyes kyi ye shes rtogs thabs yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtogs zin nas slar yang rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad pa mi rigs/ des na kun gzhi 'di ka lhan skyes kyi ye shes mtshan nyid par 'khrul par ni mi rigs te/ kun mkhyen klu sgrub pas/ da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma 'di'ang dwangs snyigs gnyis su phye nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi gsal stong zung du 'jug pa de lhan skyes kyi ye shes yin zhes gsungs pa ni de kho na bzhin lags kyang / yang de nyid kun gzhi yin gsungs pa kho bo cag gis khas len mi nus te/

ci'i phyir zhe na/ gong gi skyon rnams kyang 'jug par ma zad/ jo bo rjes kyang / kun gzhi thams cad mkhyen par khas len pa'i grub mtha' rags pa de 'dra phyi rol mu stegs pa la'ang med ces gsungs so/ /lhan skyes kyi ye shes lag mthil gyi skyu ru ra ltar ngo sprod bya zhes gsungs 'dug na'ang / de de ltar du ngo sprod byed par shin tu dka' ste lung rigs mang du 'dug na'ang yi ge'i 'jigs pas ma spros/ des na kun gzhir 'dod pa ni da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma la 'dod cing / 'di ni gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa'i rgyun re zhig ma skyes tsam gyi bar skabs skad cig ma zhig yin pa ma gtogs/ de'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa je srab tu song nas 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs mthong ba ni ma yin/ rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi ye shes dngos ni gzung 'dzin je srab tu song ba'i tshe rang mdangs je gsal du 'gro dgos rgyu zhig yin par 'dod/ de ltar gnyis su phye ba'i kun gzhi'i rang bzhin yang / de'i yig chung las/ sems myong rig bye brag tu ma phye ba/ ris sam phyogs su ma chad pa/ thabs rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid la kun gzhi zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir kun gzhi zhes bya na/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i gzhir gyur pas so/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'di'i don 'grel tshul yang mi 'dra ba mang tsam mchis rung / don du myong rig ces pas rnam shes yin pa dang / ye shes ma yin pa dang / 'dus byas yin pa'i don rnams bstan te/ rnam shes yin na 'dus byas yin pas khyab pa'i tshul yang / 'dus byas thams cad/ bems po shes pa ldan min 'du byed gsum gyis bsdus pa las 'di shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ mi rtag par yang grub ste/ 'dus byas yin na mi rtag pas khyab par ma zad/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ gang gi rnam shes skad cig ma/ /de yi de nyid rtag ma yin/ /sems ni mi rtag nyid yin na/

/stong pa nyid dang ji ltar 'gal/ /mdor na sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /sems ni mi rtag nyid bzhed na/ /de dag sems ni stong nyid du/ /ci yi phyir na bzhed mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ 'o na ye shes ma yin par cis bstan zhe na/ myong rig ces gsungs pa de gas bstan te/ bde sdug myong ba po rnam par shes pa yin gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis bde sdug myong bar mi rigs pa'i phyir/ yul gyi dbang gis rnam shes kyi tshogs gzhan so sor rgya ma chad pas bye brag tu ma phye ba/ dge mi dge gang gi phyogs su yang ma lhung ba'i lung ma bstan yin pas na ris sam phyogs su ma chad pa/ rnam rtog gi dbang du ma btang bar rang gi rgyun bsrings pas gnyug ma'i gnas lugs mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir thabs/ ma 'ongs pa'i shes pa ma yin pa'i phyir rig pa/ da lta ba yin pas gsal ba/ 'das pa ma yin pas ma 'gags pa/ ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pas stong pa nyid du bzhed cing / 'on kyang de nyid gong du bshad pa ltar gnas lugs la sgrib par byed pa'i gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri ma dang ma bral ba'i shes pa yin pa las 'os med cing / gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi ye shes yin na 'khor ba'i rgyu dang rtsa bar bzhag mi rung bar sems te/ de'i snang ba 'char ba'i rgyu rkyen ma tshang ba'i phyir/ 'o na mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshe gang gi steng du 'jog ce na/ kun gzhi rang nyid ma bcos pa'i steng du 'jog 'on te de nyid yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin te/ 'khrul pa'i sems kyi steng du bzhag pa'i phyir snyam na/ skyon med de/ bal yul gyi lam brgyud de phyin pas rgya gar du brtol ba dang mtshungs so/ /lar gnyug ma'i ye shes ma 'khrul pa'i steng du 'jog rgyu byung na lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ dang po nyid nas de ltar rngo mi thogs/ 'o na gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi ye shes de kun gzhi 'di dang tha dad dam snyam na/ de yang ma yin te/

dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ de la rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i sems gang yin pa dang / sems de'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gang yin pa de gnyis ni dge ba dang mi dge ba'i sems gcig la rgyu bas/ sems gnyis par mtshams sbyor ba med pa'i tshul gyis zag pa med pa'i dbyings la mchog tu rtogs par dka' ba yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zag pa med pa'i dbyings la sgrib par mi byed pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems rgyud de gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi ye shes 'di yin pa'i phyir kun gzhi las tha dad pa ma yin yang / da lta nyon mongs pa dang bcas te gnas pa'i phyir chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs par dka' bas/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / sa yi nang na yod pa'i chu/ /dri ma med par gnas pa ltar/ /nyon mongs nang na ye shes kyang / /de bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /zhes dang / gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa'i chos dbyings dang / bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /dri ma med pa'i yid la rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa'i bde gshegs snying po'i rten du gyur cing gang la sgrib par mi byed pa'i gsal rig dngos ni gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi ye shes 'di la 'dod/ ngo bo ni gong du bshad pa ltar dbyer med de/ kun gzhi'i steng du 'khrul pa'i dri ma dag pa'i tshe ye shes yin par 'dod pa las gang du mi sems te/ de'i phyir/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi 'grel par yang de lta bu'i rang bzhin gsum legs par ngo sprod na lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ 'o na de ga'i mjug tu sems can gyi khams thams cad la ngo bo nyid kyis de ltar gnas kyang zhes gsungs pa la dpags na kun gzhi ngo 'phrod pa de ga ye shes su bzhed pa ma yin nam snyam na/

de yang ngo bo dbyer med pa dang / chos kyi dbyings khyad med du bzhugs pa la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin gyi/ ngo sprod pa'i sems de 'khrul bral ye shes mtshan nyid par bzhed pa ma yin/ de ltar bzhed na rgyu dus kyi lta ba dug can/ so so'i grub mtha' la 'dod zhen dang bcas pa'i lta ba sogs kyi rnam gzhag mdzad par mi rigs/ yang rnam 'grel las lus la rten 'brel 'grigs pas rtogs par bya rgyu sems kun gzhi yin pas so zhes gsungs pa'ang de'i gnas lugs gnyug ma'i ye shes la dgongs pa yin gyi/ thog mar ngo sprad pa'i kun gzhi de la gsungs pa ma yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sa skya pa chen po'i gzhung bshad sras don ma las kyang / ma dag pa kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la zhing khams su rnam par gzhag pa dang / lus thabs rgyud la zhing khams su rnam par gzhag pa dang / dag pa'i snang ba ye shes gcig la zhing khams su rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du/ lung sbyor gyi skabs su ye shes kyi lung kun gzhir drangs pa rnams kyang gdod nas ye shes yin pa'i phyir myang 'das kyi rgyu dang rtsa rgyud sogs su bzhag nas rang bzhin lhun grub tu bstan pa la dgongs kyi gzung 'dzin dang ma bral ba'i shes pa skad cig ma dang sbyar te bshad du mi rung ste/ kun gzhi'i yig chung las/ de'ang kun gzhi nyid phyi rol gyi yul gyi zhen pa la brten nas chags sdang skye bas zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di ga ye shes su 'dod na ye shes kyang chags sdang gi dbang du 'gro bar khas len dgos par 'gyur/ 'o na gong ma rnams kyis kyang / 'di ni kun gzhi'o/ /'di ni ye shes so zhes so sor phye nas gsungs rigs pa la de ltar mi gsungs pa ci zhe na/ las dang po pas lta ba bsgom pa'i yul ni gong du smos pa ltar kun gzhi rang gis 'thus shing / de ga'i steng du bzhag cing rgyun bskyangs pas 'khyags pa zhu bas chur 'gyur ba bzhin ye shes phyi nas skye bar 'gyur ba yang /

rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis do ha mdzod las/ bsam dang bsam bya rab tu spangs nas su/ /ji ltar bu chung tshul gyis gnas bya zhing / /bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te gus 'bad na/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pas rtogs nus pa dang / ye shes logs su phye nas gsungs rung / gang zag rang gi rgyud la ma skyes par de'i steng du 'jog par mi shes pas/ /des na so sor phye nas dngos su ma bstan kyang / shugs las ni/ rtogs pa'i khyad par zla ba'i dpe yis bstan/ /zhes pa'i skabs su mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes chu nang gi zla ba dang cha 'dra bar bstan pa las/ ye shes dngos ma yin par gsungs na de'ang ma skyes pa'i gong gi shes pa skad cig ma kun gzhir ngo sprad pa de ye shes su ci'i phyir bzhed de/ de bzhin du rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ dang po sprin dang 'dra ba yin/ /grub pa sgyu ma lta bur 'gyur/ /gnyid log sad pa mi phyed pa/ /rtag tu rmi lam 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes zhu bde lhan skyes kyi rgyun bskyangs pa'i 'bras bu rang bzhin lhan skyes mthong ba'i sa mtshams bstan pa'i skabs su gsungs pa 'di nyid kyi don yang / mnga' ris pa'i 'grel pa las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mi gsal ba tsam du rtogs pa drod chung ngu'i dus so/ /'bring gi dus su grub pa zhes pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mnyam bzhag la mngon du grub pas sgyu ma lta bur 'gyur zhes pa rjes kyi dus na'o/ /chen po'i dus na mnyam rjes med par chos thams cad lhan skyes kyi ngo bor rtogs pas/ nyal dang log pa'i khyad par las/ /rtag tu rmi lam 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /zhes sbyor lam ma thob par lhan skyes kyi ye shes mi mthong bar dngos su bstan/ yang rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib/ /de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis kun gzhi dang /

phyi mas dri ma med pa'i ye shes dngos su bstan 'dug pa'i ro legs par myang na kho bos rnam par phye ba 'di nyid kyi rgyab rten bla na med par grub cing / de yang / tshig rkang dang po mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu rgyud kyi lung dang / bar pas 'khor ba'i rgyu rgyud du 'jog pa'i lung du grub/ phyi ma ni thabs lam nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa na sangs rgyas nyid ces pas de las gzhan du mi 'da' bar bstan pa'i phyir/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi ye shes kun gzhir bzhag na lung 'di dang yang dngos 'gal du 'gyur/ yang rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan du/ de nyid la/ gnyis med dam/ zung 'jug gam/ brjod bral lam/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo'am/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes ming tsam/ brda tsam/ tha snyad tsam/ brjod pa tsam du nges pa'i shes pa 'drongs par byas la zhes gsungs pa'ang ngo bo ye shes yin pa la dgongs kyi/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma dang bral bar bzhed pa ma yin te/ de nyid las/ rgyud gsum gyi rgyu rgyud kyi skabs su/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid 'khor ba zhes bshad pas/ de dri ma dang ma bral ba'i gsal rig la ngos 'dzin pa las 'os med de/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi gsal rig 'khor bar bzhag tu mi rung zhing / de'ang 'khor bar bzhag na myang 'das stong pa rang rkyang las mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ yang dri ma dang bcas pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa de lhan skyes kyi ye shes yin te/ ngo bo ye shes yin pa gang zhig ma rig pa dang lhan cig tu gnas pa'i phyir snyam na/ yon tan gyi ldog cha ma 'dres par so sor rtogs phyin don gyis de ltar yin pa'i phyir rnam shes la ye shes kyi ming btags pa 'byung ste/ kha sbyor thig le'i brtag pa brgyad pa las/ dmyal ba 'jigs rung ngu ba ste/ /yi dwags ye shes nyi ma nyid/ /gti mug ye shes byol song ste/ /khro ba ye shes lha ma yin/

/gsang ba ye shes me long lha/ /mi rnams ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru cha yis 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang blo gros gsar bu bas/ 'khyags pa'i gong bur chu dngos su 'dzin pa lta bu'i 'du shes kyi skyon 'jug pa'i phyir dngos btags rnam par dbye dgos par sems/ des na mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi zin bris sogs yig cha gzhan dag gi dgongs pa'ang de kho na ltar 'grel dgos par sems shing / mdor bsdu na shes pa'i rgyun gcig las med kyang / de sgrib g.yogs dang bcas pa ni kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang / sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba ni ye shes sam zag med sems rgyud de/ de gnyis ka'i stong pa'i cha ni chos dbyings sam bde gshegs snying po yin pas khyab mnyam du khas len dgos na'ang / de bzhin nyid rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa'i bye brag gis rnam shes dang ye shes tshul gcig tu 'dzin par mi rigs par sems nas/ rang gi go ba rnams lhug par yi ger 'god pa po ni gzim 'og sprul ming byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags su 'bod pa lags na/ 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol zhing / gal te lhag pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs ba'i dge ba'ang yod srid pas de dag gis ni/ snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces gsungs la/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sems rig gi dbye ba mdzad pa dang / sa skya pa'i rnam shes dang ye shes kyi dbye ba byas pa 'di nyid phal cher gyis gnad gcig pa lta bur go bar 'dug na'ang / 'di gnyis gnad mi mtshungs te/ rdzogs pa chen pos sems 'khrul pa yin la/ rig pa'i ye shes ma 'khrul pa yin pas rig pa'i ye shes nyid rtsal du bton te mnyam par bzhag pas 'khrul snang dbyings su dengs par bzhed la/ sa skya pa rnams ni sems kun gzhi gsal ba'i cha 'di ngos zin par byas te/

de'i steng du smin grol gyi lam thams cad nyams su len pa yin la/ de yang gang zag dbang po yang rab dbang dus su don gyi ye shes skyes nas kun gzhi'i rnam shes gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa dang bcas pa 'khrul med ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba'i mgo rtsom pa'ang yod mod/ de man chad la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa'i tshul gyis smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas lugs 'di dbang lam du bya ba yin pas/ dbang dang rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de rtse gcig tu bsgom pa la brtson pas gzung 'dzin gyi sgrib pa je srab tu song / gnyis med ye shes kyi gsal snang rim gyis gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i tshe'ang kun rdzob thabs kyi cha'i yon tan rnams kyang gong 'phel du 'gro la/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams kyi snang ba la rnam shes ye shes su gnas 'gyur 'dug snyam pa 'byung mod/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin pas gnas gyur pa mtshan nyid pa ma yin la/ sa dang por gnas 'gyur gyi mgo brtsams nas bsgom lam sa bcu gnyis pa'i mjug sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed la/ rnam shes kyi cha phra ba'i phra ba'ang gnas gyur te sku dang ye shes yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdzod du gyur nas rtag khyab lhun grub kyi phrin las kyis 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can gyi don mdzad par bzhed la/ de'ang sa dang po nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du kun rdzob thabs kyi yon tan sangs rgyas brgya mthong ba la sogs pa gong 'phel du 'gro bar bzhed cing / sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gzugs kyi sku dang / phrin las gdul bya la snang ba'i cha rnams la kun rdzob kyi ming gis 'dogs par mdzad de/ kun rdzob yin na mtha' gcig tu spang byar zhal gyis mi bzhed pa yin no/ /gzhi'i skabs su bden gnyis zung 'jug dgos pa'i rgyab rten du/ rim lnga las/ gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa zhes/ /rnam gnyis blo ni yod min zhing /

/gang du mi phyed blor snang ba/ /de ni zung du 'jug par bshad/ /ces dang / lam gyi skabs su bden gnyis zung 'jug dgos pa'i sgrub byed du/ bskyed pa'i rim pa 'di gcig dang / /gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i rim pa dag /gnyis po gang du gcig gyur pa/ /de ni zung du 'jug par bshad/ /ces dang / 'bras bu'i skabs su bden gnyis zung 'jug dgos pa'i sgrub byed du/ zung 'jug rim la gnas pa de/ /de ni kun mkhyen de nyid mthong / /zhes klu sgrub kyi lung dang sbyor bar mdzad do/ /glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub pa'i zhal nas/ don dam la yang yul dang yul can gnyis/ /zung 'jug la yang dbyings dang ye shes gnyis/ gnyis med la yang kun rdzob don dam gnyis/ /lhan skyes la yang gnyis su gsungs par shes/ /don dam kun rdzob ming 'dogs gang dang gang / /phyogs re kho nar bshad pa'i nges pa med/ /don sgra ji bzhin rtogs par byed na ni/ /blo gros 'khrul zhes byams pa mgon pos gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas 'gyur ba'i ye shes de la'ang mtshon byed dpe dang / mtshon bya don gyi ye shes kyi ngos nas bstan pa dang / don dam dbyings 'dus ma byas pa rtogs pa'i cha nas dang / thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi cha nas bshad pa lta bu yod pas/ phyogs gcig kho nar 'dzin mi rung ba yin no/ /da ni spyi don gsum pa lugs 'di dang mi mthun pa'i grub mtha' gsar pa gzhan dgag pa ni/ bla ma blo gros rin chen zhes bya ba zhig gis chos rgyal don grub pa zhes bya ba'i bzhed skong du bris pa/ lam 'bras rgyu rgyud sogs kyi ngos 'dzin gsar du byas pa mun bral nyi ma'i zer zhes bya ba bris so/ /khong gi tshig sbyor la dpags na mkhas pa chen po zhig yin rung / brjod bya'i don rnams rdzogs chen dang lam 'bras gnyis bsres nas bshad pa zhig 'dug la/ 'di la dogs pa dpyad dgos pa yin no/

/de la gal te khyod rdzogs pa chen po'i grub mtha' la ma gus pa yod dam zhe na/ mkhas grub chen po rgyal sras gzhan phan snang ba dang / grub dbang 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje gnyis char las chos 'di'i smin grol gyi gdams pa thos shing / bla ma gnyis la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes yod la/ chos la bsgoms pa'i nyams myong med kyang go yul gyi mos gus yod pas dgag pa yid la mi dran na ngag gis brjod pa lta ci smos/ rdzogs pa chen po'i grub mtha' 'di dang / gsung ngag lam 'bras gnyis mthar thug gi skyel so nges par gcig pas dgongs pa mthun mod/ gnas skabs kyi lam gyis bkri tshul gtan nas mi 'dra bas gcig gi dgongs pa gcig la bsres nas bshad na sprang po'i zas bzhin du lugs gang dang yang mi mthun pa zhig red 'gro ba yin pas lugs so sor dbye ba tsam las chos dang grub mtha' gzhan la dgag pa ma yin pa'i gnad shes dgos so/ de la khong gi bstan bcos 'di'i dbu zhabs kyi tshig thams cad la dgag pa byas na mang po 'dug rung / gnad bsdus te cung zad brjod na/ rgyu rgyud ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'thad pa dang / de'i dogs dpyod mi 'thad pa dang / rgyu rgyud ngos 'dzin gyi dbang gis thabs rgyud kyi gnad 'khrul par bstan pa dgag pa dang / gong ma'i gsung rab kyi lung sbyor mdzad pa rang nyid kyi skabs kyi brjod bya dang mi 'grig pa'i tshul bstan pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ khong gi gzhung du rje btsun gyis/ sems myong rig sogs gsungs pa'i 'bru snon la/ gnas lugs kyi rang bzhin ni sems nyid bde gshegs snying po so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyis myong ba'am spyod yul du gyur pa ste/ rig mdangs dbyings su 'khyil bas myong rig bye brag tu ma phye ba/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gyi ris sam mtshan mar ma grub cing / yod med dang rtag chad kyi phyogs su nam yang ma lhung ba'o/

/ngo bo'i yin lugs ni snying rje chen po thabs kyi bdag nyid can rig mdangs gsal la 'char gzhi go ma 'gags pa/ de'ang ngo bo la bri gang med pas rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du gnas pa ste/ tshul de lta bu'i yin lugs la kun gzhi zhes 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi gyur pa ste/ bde gshegs snying po'i rang ngo la 'khor 'das kyi tha snyad ma grub kyang / thabs snying rje chen po'i mdangs 'gags pa med pa'i rtsal las/ rig dang ma rig gi ldog chas 'khor 'das su grub pas na de ltar du bzhag pa ste/ zhes bris 'dug pa 'di gtan nas mi 'thad de/ rje btsun rin po ches/ sems myong rig sogs gsungs pa'i tshig gi 'bru snon tshar ngor gyi skyes chen sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba dag gis/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung dang mi 'gal bar bris pa rnams dang gtan nas mi mthun pa zhig byas 'dug pa 'di/ khong gi zhe phug tu rdzogs pa chen po'i rig pa'i ye shes spros pa dang bral ba de bzhag nas kha nas sa skya pa'i lugs kyi kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin 'di bzhin yin no zhes nan gyis bshad 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rig pa'i ye shes spros pa dang bral ba de gzhi'i gnas lugs yin kyang sa skya pa'i lugs kyi kun gzhi rgyu rgyud gtan nas ma yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud don bdun gyi sgo nas rje btsun gong mas gsungs pa thams cad dang mi 'grig pa'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar mi 'grig ce na/ don dang po kun gzhi'i rang bzhin gsal rig tu gong ma brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas gsungs pa la/ khyed kyis rnam shes gsal ba'i cha 'khrul pa yin pas rgyu rgyud du khas len mi rung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ don gnyis pa rten dkyil 'khor bzhi yang kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du gong mas gsungs pa la/ khyed kyis gzhung du rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kho na las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i chos nyi shu rtsa bdun po rgyu rgyud min te sol ba bkrus na dkar por mi rung ba'i dpe dang bcas te bshad 'dug pas mi 'grig pa'i phyir/

don gsum pa rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la brten pa kun gzhi'i gsal cha me tog dang me tog gi dri'i tshul du brten par gsungs pa la/ khyod kyis rten brten pa gnyis ka kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du mi 'dod par 'dug pa'i phyir/ don bzhi pa rgyu rgyud du 'gro tshul dang / don lnga pa rtsa rgyud du 'gro tshul gnyis phyogs gcig tu brjod na/ dpal mgon klus/ gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dbyings spros pa dang bral ba la dgongs te ngo shes na mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu dang rtsa bar 'gro ba yin la/ ngo ma shes na 'khor ba'i rgyu dang rtsa bar 'jog pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang mang du 'byung mod/ kun rdzob gsal ba'i cha la dgongs te rten dkyil 'khor bzhi 'di thabs khyad par can gyis zin na sku bzhir gnas 'gyur ba yin pas mya ngan la 'das pa'i rgyu dang rtsa ba yin la/ thabs kyis ma zin na 'khor ba'i rgyu dang rtsa ba yin pa dang / de bzhin du phung khams skye mched 'di thabs khyad par can gyis zin na gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i ngo bo yin pas mya ngan las pa'i rgyu dang rtsa ba yin la/ thabs kyis ma zin na 'khor ba'i rgyu dang rtsa ba dang / nyon mongs dug lnga thabs kyis zin na ye shes lnga'i ngo bo yin pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu dang rtsa ba dang / thabs kyis ma zin na 'khor ba'i rgyu dang rtsa bar 'jog tshul 'di rnams gong ma'i gsung rab/ de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos/ kha 'don lam dus kyi nyams len dang bcas pa'i nang du yang yang 'byung ba yin pas/ dbyings spros pa dang bral ba kho na rgyu rgyud du khas blangs nas/ sems gsal ba'i cha rgyu rgyud du khas ma blangs na gong ma'i dgongs pa dang 'grig mi 'grig legs par dpyod dang da shes par 'gyur ro/ /don drug pa phyi nang gi 'brel ni/

phyi na yod tshad lus la rtsa khams kyi tshul du yod la/ lus la yod tshad sems gsal ba'i steng na bag chags kyi tshul du yod par gsungs pa la/ rtog ges tshad ma 'chad pa'i tshe don shes rang mtshan skad cig ma'i steng du 'gal 'brel 'jog ma nus par gzhan sel gyi sgo nas 'jog dgos par bshad na/ dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bag chags kyi tshul du yod pa'i phyi nang gi 'brel ji ltar brtsi/ des na phyi nang gi 'brel tshul 'di'ang khyod la mi 'thad pa yin no/ /don bdun pa 'khor 'das tshang tshul/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad mtshan nyid kyi tshul du tshang / lam gyi chos thams cad yon tan gyi tshul du tshang / 'bras bu'i chos thams cad nus mthu'i tshul du tshang gsungs na/ khyed kyi rgyu rgyud dbyings spros pa dang bral ba 'di'i steng du/ dmyal ba rdo rje gdan gyi btso bsreg gi sdug bsngal mtshan nyid kyi tshul du tshang bas 'gal ba'i khur chen po 'di khyed kyis khur dgos pa yin no/ /gal te rig pa'i ye shes spros pa dang bral ba 'di 'khor 'das kyi spros pa thams cad gcod byed yin pas 'gal khur 'di khas mi len no zhe na/ khyed lugs gzhan gyi brgyud 'dzin yin na khur ma blangs kyang btub mod/ khyed sa skya pa'i bstan pa la gces par 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin zhig yin par zhal gyis bzhes shing / rje btsun gong mas/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la rigs drug gi bde sdug mtshan nyid kyi tshul du tshang bar gsungs pas/ khyod kyis thugs bskyed kyi dbang gis 'gal ba'i khur chen po 'di rnams re zhig mi khur ba'i thabs med pa yin no/ /smras pa/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i gar/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon brgyud pa'i rang lugs ni/ /sa brdzus 'di yis smras bzhin min no zhes/ /sa skya pa des gsal ba'i ngag gis bshad/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad do/

/khong gis rgyu rgyud bde gshegs snying po'i rang ngo la 'khor 'das kyi tha snyad ma grub par bshad pa dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud ces pa'i tshig 'di gnyis 'gal lam mi 'gal dpyad pas shes pa yin no/ /gnyis pa de'i dogs dpyod mi 'thad pa ni/ khong gi gzhung du/ la la dag rgyu lhan cig skyes pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug gsum gyi gsal cha ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes sam rgyu rgyud dang / las nyon bag chags sog pa'i rten dang / stong cha ni khams bde gshegs snying po dri bcas sam/ chos dbyings zhes ldog cha tsam las zung 'jug tu ston pa rang lugs bla ma gong ma'i phyag len no zhes 'chad la/ de ni bden te/ 'di ni kha cig byis pa rnams/ /re zhig chos dbyings dri med la/ /yid mi ches pa drang pa'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar re zhig las dang po pa la dgongs nas de ltar bzhag pa'i gzhung yod du chug na ni los chog nges pa ltar na 'dis ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes rgyu rgyud du khas blangs pas/ rgyud gsum gnod 'joms sogs snga phyi ci rigs pas bkag zin la/ bde gshegs snying po'ang gsal cha nas 'jog pa ni mang du mchis te stong rkyang du 'dod pa ni lam 'bras pa'i min nam snyam/ dri bcas kyang lam dus su bzhag na ni glo bur ba'i dri ma sbyang byar gnas pas 'thad la/ gzhi dus su 'jog pa gtan nas mi legs te/ bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad nas ma gsungs so zhes pa la sogs pa mang po bris la/ 'di dag mi 'thad pa'i tshul ni/ kun gzhi'i gsal cha bag chags kyi rten dang / stong cha snying po dri bcas su khas len pa dgongs pa can yin zhes pa kun mkhyen chen po'i lam 'bras khog phug dang / dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gong ma'i dgongs rgyan sogs la gtad 'dug mod/ 'di la mi 'thad pa'i cha med de/ khong gi bsam yul la/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'khrul pa yin pas rgyu rgyud du khas len mi rung zer ba'i don du 'di bshad snang yang /

kun gzhi'i rnam shes rgyu rgyud du khas len pa la nyes pa ci'ang med tshul bshad zin la/ 'di rgyud gsum gnod 'joms kyis bkag yod zer ba rtsa 'grel gnyis char na med pas/ rjes 'jug mgo rmongs pa'i thabs su brdzun bshad pa yin no/ /gsal cha la bde gshegs snying por 'jog pa yod ces pa ni/ sher phyin rong ṭīka sogs na de 'dra gsungs yod mod/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung las bshad pa ma mthong la/ stong cha la snying por 'dod pa lam 'bras pa'i min zer ba sems kyi rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub pa'i chos nyid zung 'jug la snying por bshad pa'ang yod mod/ gtso che ba'i ngos nas gsal cha la kun gzhi dang / stong cha la snying por gsungs pa 'di ngor chen gyi rgyud gsum gnod 'joms 'grel pa/ kun mkhyen gyi lam 'bras khog phub/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dgongs rgyan sogs na bzhugs pas 'di rnams lam 'bras pa yin snyam mo/ /rgyu rgyud dri bcas su 'jog pa gtan nas mi 'thad cing / bka' bstan bcos thams cad na med do zhes pa ni ha cang thal te/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /ces pa rgyu rgyud dri bcas su ston pa'i lung yin no/ /de bzhin du/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /sogs nas/ bde ba gang phyir mi shes pa/ /rtag tu rang bzhin bde ba can/ /zhes pa dang / lha so so'i rgyu rgyud kyi dag pa ston byed/ /lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bzhin lag kha dog gnas pa ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pas so/ /zhes pa 'di'ang rgyu rgyud dri bcas su ston pa'i lung yin no/ /der ma zad/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes sogs dang / zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar nas gsungs pa'i rgyud tshig thams cad rgyu rgyud dri bcas su ston pa'i lung yin te/

rgyu rgyud dri bcas de nyid/ thabs rgyud kyis dri ma sbyangs te/ dag pa gnyis ldan du gyur pa 'bras rgyud du zhal gyis bzhes pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud bla ma las/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med/ /dri med sangs rgyas zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dri bcas de bzhin nyid rgyu rgyud dri bcas su ston pa'i lung yin no/ /de bzhin du/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ma dag pa dang / dri 'di dag gis byis rnams dang / /dgra bcom slob pa blo ldan rnams/ /rim bzhin bzhi dang gnyis (gcig )dang ni/ /gnyis dang gnyis kyis ma dag nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i dang po yang rgyu rgyud dri bcas su ston pa'i lung yin no/ /klu sgrub kyis/ nyon mongs dra bas g.yogs pa na/ /sems can zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /de nyid nyon mongs bral gyur na/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshig rkang dang po gnyis rgyu rgyud dri bcas su ston byed yin pas brtag gnyis la bka' dang / byams mgon klu sgrub gnyis kyi gsung bstan bcos kyi gral du brtsi dgos pa 'dra'o/ /gal te klu sgrub kyis/ sa yi dkyil na yod pa'i chu/ /dri ma med par gnas pa ltar/ /nyon mongs nang na ye shes kyang / /de bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /zhes pa 'di rgyu rgyud dri bral du ston byed ma yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ 'di'i dri ma med par gnas zhes pa rang bzhin rnam dag la dgongs pa yin la/ de rang lugs la bzhed pa yin te rang bzhin la gnas 'gyur mi bzhed pa'i gnad kyang de yin no/ /nyon mongs nang na zhes pa'i tshig zur 'dis rgyu rgyud dri bcas su bstan pa yin no/ /tshig 'di la 'khrul nas/ nyon mongs pa phyi dang / ye shes nang na yod pa lta bu la go mi rung ste/ sdom gsum rang mchan las/ nyon mongs pa dang ye shes 'dres nas skye bas de 'byed pa la lam 'bras lta bu'i gdams ngag dgos gsungs pa nyon mongs pa nyid ye shes su 'char dgos gsungs pa yin no/

/des na khong gi gzhung 'dir rnam shes la lam du byed pa dang / sems gsal cha ngos bzung nas nyams len byas kyang gzugs khams su skye ba dang / sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' tsam las dbu ma par yang mi 'gyur zhes sogs mang po bris 'dug pa 'di/ dang po nyid nas blo bral gyi ye shes la nyams len snying po byed dgos kyi kun rdzob thabs kyi cha la slob mi dgos so zhes zer ba 'dra bas 'di'i gnad bshad na sa skya pa rnams kyis mtha' bral gyi lta ba rgyas par bshad pa'i skabs su/ blo bral gyi ye shes ngos bzung ste grub thob rnams kyi do ha dang / rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung dang mthun par 'chad mod/ nyams len bsgom pa'i dus su lta ba de'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ thabs kun rdzob kyi cha mi spong bar thabs shes zung 'jug gi tshul du nyams su len pa yin pas/ rje btsun gyis/ lam thams cad gcig tu bsdebs te ston pa 'di rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i lugs yin no zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /des na sdom gsum rab dbyes phyag rdzogs kyi grub mtha' bkag go zhes ri bong cal 'drog smra mod/ smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis/ yan lag dam tshig dang sdom pa sogs tshul bzhin du bsten dgos so zhes gsungs pa tsam las/ lta ba'i ngos nas phyag rdzogs la smad pa mi snang ngo / /gzhan yang khong gis snang ba sems su sgrub pas sems tsam dang mnyam/ sgyu mar sgrub pas rang rgyud 'og ma/ rang bzhin med par sgrub pas rang rgyud gong ma/ rang bzhin med pa brjod bral du sgrub pas gdod thal 'gyur gnyis stong gi ye shes zhes sogs bris pa 'di rang lugs ma yin te/ rje yab sras kyis/ sa skya pas rten 'brel brjod bral du sgrub pas dbu ma pa ma yin no gsungs pa la ngor chen gyis/ rang bzhin med par sgrub pa la/ rten 'brel du sgrub pa dang / brjod bral du sgrub pa gnyis dbye ba las/

rten 'brel brjod bral du sgrub pa ni nam yang min par shes par bya'o zhes gsungs pa la/ 'dis rang bzhin med pa'ang da gzod brjod bral du bsgrub pa sogs gong ma'i gsung la brtag dpyad mi byed par yid la gang dran yi ger bris pa shin tu mang bar snang ngo / /de dag la 'di skad du/ ha cang thal ba'i ham pa yis/ /'khrul med rang lugs 'khrul par bsgrags/ /blo gros ldan pa'i blo stobs kyis/ /de ma thag tu de sun dbyung / /zhes kyang smras so/ /gsum pa rgyu rgyud ngos 'dzin gyi dbang gis thabs rgyud kyi gnad 'khrul par bstan pa dgag pa ni/ khong gis tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ dkon mchog gsum dngos dngos grub kun gyi bdag /rgyud don smra mkhas mkhas pa kun gyi rje/ /phrin las lhun grub grub dbang rdo rje 'dzin/ /dam pa'i zhabs pad pad+mor gtsug gis btud/ /ces pa dang / yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa byang phyogs na/ /gangs kyi bsil ba'i gdugs dkar bsil yab la/ /sa skya pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan can/ /gang de'i bdag po deng dus khyod kho na/ /zhes sogs drangs nas thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub la bstod ra yang byas 'dug mod/ dkon mchog lhun grub rang nyid kyi gsung / thun mong dag tu brjod rung 'ga' tsam zhig /'chad par 'gyur gyis mkha' 'gros skabs phye zhig /ces pa 'di drangs nas/ lam 'bras tshogs bshad 'di sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa dang / ldem por dgongs pa'i chings che zhes pa dang / gang zag dbang po tha ma'i nyams len yin zhes dang / dpe hrul mang po la dgos pa med ces pa dang / rgyu rgyud blo bral gyi ye shes ngos zin nas/ rnam shes dang bcas pa'i thabs kyi cha thams cad spangs te/ bla ma'i mos gus kyi sgo nas grol ba 'di gang zag dbang po rab kyi chos yin pas nyams len gyi snying po 'di kho na la 'bad dgos zhes dang / der ma zad khong gis sems dang sems nyid kyi dbye ba ston pa'i bstan bcos zhig kyang byas 'dug pa de'i nang na/

sems zhes pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad yin la/ de chos dbyings kyi sgrib byed snyigs ma'i cha yin la/ ye shes zhes pa sems nyid chos dbyings mthar thug dwangs ma'i cha yin pas/ 'di'i dwangs snyigs ma phyes na ji ltar bsgoms kyang gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa las mi 'da' zhes sogs mang po zhig bris 'dug pa la/ sems dang sems nyid kyi dbye ba 'di sa skya pas rnam shes dang ye shes kyi dbye ba byas pa dang gnad mthun na sngar ma grags pa tsam ma gtogs don la mi 'gal mod/ khong gis sems dang sems nyid kyi dbye ba 'di rdzogs chen gyi sems rig phye tshul dang gnad gcig par 'dug pas/ mthar thug gi dgongs pa mi 'gal yang / lam nyams su len pa'i dus su gsung ngag gi gzhung dang mi 'grig ste/ khong gis las dang po pas sems dang sems nyid phyes te/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyis ma gos pa'i nyams len zhig la da lta nas chig dril dgos gsungs kyin 'dug la/ lam 'bras pas/ rnam shes lam du byas te bsgom pas rim gyis dri ma dag ste/ sa bcu gsum pa'i sa phyed la rnam shes tshogs brgyad ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur bar gsungs pas mi mthun pa yin no/ /khong gi tshig thams cad la re re nas dgag pa byas na mang bar 'gyur bas/ gnad don snying po brjod na/ sa skya pa rnams kyis snang ba sems su bsgrubs te 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems gsal ba'i cho 'phrul du ngo 'phrod pa'i tshe/ sems de'i rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid la yid ches bskyed nas gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang nas sems gsal ba'i steng du thabs rgyud kyi nyams len gyi gnad rnams tshang ba'i tshul la nges shes bskyed de/ thabs rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig po sgom par byed pa yin la/ khong gis/ sems gsal ba'i cha 'di gnyug ma'i ye shes kyi sgrib byed yin cing / mngon rtogs bcu gcig po drang don dgongs pa can yin pas mi zab pa yin pas snying po med do zhes kha nas ma bton kyang /
