don gyis rgyud gsum gyi nyams len thams cad la co 'dri bar 'dug pas 'di la brjod par bya ste/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ thun mong dag tu brjod rung gsungs pa'i dgongs pa lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi skabs kyi phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad thun mong ma yin pa dang / 'khor 'das thun mong gi chos bdun gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len tshul dang / rgyud gsum rgyas bshad kyi 'khor 'das bsre ba'i zab gnad rnams dmigs khrid du ma gsungs pa la dgongs pa yin gyis/ rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan du gsungs pa'i nyams len rnams drang don du ston byed ga la yin/ yin na mjug tu/ nges don bstan pa'i rgyan 'di kho bos byas/ /zhes dang / 'di na 'chad po gzhan gyis ma bslabs pa'i/ /'di phyi bar do'i lam khyer mang mchis pa/ /'di kun dam pa'i drin las rnyed pa ste/ /zhes nges don gyi zab gnad yod par gsungs kyi zab gnad med par ma gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyu rgyud ngos 'dzin gsar du byas pa yis/ /brgyud pa mchog 'di'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i/ /rgyud gsum lam gyi nyams len kun spong ba/ /brgyud 'dzin 'di la su zhig yid rton byed/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /bzhi pa gong ma'i gsung rab kyi lung sbyor mdzad pa rang nyid kyi skabs kyi brjod bya dang mi 'grigs pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ spyir khong gis grub mtha' gzhan gyi chos skad dang bsres nas rtsal du bton te rigs pa'i 'ur rdo 'phangs pa 'di dag brgyud 'dzin la 'phangs pa ltar byas snang yang / phog pa rdo rje 'chang dang brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba dag gi gsung rab kyi dbu la phog 'dug pa 'di rjes 'jug rnams kyis shes dgos te/ de'ang kun gzhi'i ngo bo/ ris sam phyogs su ma chad pa gsungs pa de snga ma rnams kyis dge sdig gang gi phyogs su ma lhung bar gsungs pa la/

khong gis zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gyi ris sam mtshan mar ma grub ces pa/ rtsa rgyud kyi/ lha so so'i rgyu rgyud kyi dag pa ston byed/ lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bzhin lag kha dog gnas pa ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa la phog 'dug pa dang / rten dkyil 'khor bzhi sogs phung khams skye mched rnams rgyu rgyud du mi rung bar bshad pa 'di/ gnyags ma la sogs pa'i gzhung bshad dang / ngor chen la sogs pa'i brgyud 'dzin thams cad kyi gsung rab la phog 'dug pa dang / lung rnams kyang skabs kyi brjod bya dang mi 'grig pa'i tshul ni/ sems kyi gsal cha rang bzhin stong pa dang ma bral ba 'di kun gzhi rgyu rgyud yin tshul/ kun mkhyen chen pos lam 'bras khog phub tu rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs pa la/ sems kyi gsal cha kun gzhir khas blangs na kun mkhyen gyi dgongs pa min zhes sdom gsum kha skong gi lung drangs nas bshad 'dug pa 'di brjod bya dang lung mi 'grig pa yin no/ /de bzhin du ngor chen gyis rgyud gsum gnod 'joms kyi 'grel par/ sems gsal rig rgyun mi 'chad pa 'di la mdo phyogs nas kun gzhi dang len pa'i rnam shes sogs su bshad la/ sngags nas rgyu'i rgyud dang / myong rig dang / snang mched thob gsum sogs ming gzhan gyis bstan pa yin zhes gsungs pa la/ rang nyid kyi sems kyi gsal cha 'khrul pa yin pas rig pa'i ye shes kho na rgyu rgyud du 'dod pa'i rgyab rten du rgyud gsum gnod 'joms kyi/ des na rgyud 'di'i lhan skyes ni/ /bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs drangs pa 'di'ang brjod bya dang mi 'grig pa yin no/ /rang nyid kyis sems dang rig pa tha dad du phyes nas/ sems kyi steng du nyams len byas pas khams gsum las mi 'da' ba'i sgrub byed du/ /bdag nyid chen po'i gsung / 'jig rten rnam rtog ma log pa'i/

/chos pa bzang yang srid rtse yin/ /zhes pa drangs pa 'di brjod bya dang mi 'grig te/ chos rje'i dgongs pa stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo dang mi ldan na 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan gyis srid rtse las mi 'da' gsungs pa yin gyi/ sems rig 'byed pa'i rgyab rten ma yin pas 'di'ang brjod bya dang mi 'grig pa yin no/ /yang khong gis mdzad pa'i sems dang sems nyid kyi dbye ba ston pa gsal ba'i me long zhes pa de dang gzhung 'di gnyis char gyi nang na/ chos nyid bde gshegs snying po spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de rgyu rgyud dang sems nyid yin la/ sems kyi gsal cha rnam shes kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi cha rnams kun rdzob 'khrul pa dang sems yin pas/ 'di gnyis tha dad du phye dgos zhes pa'i rgyab rten du/ chos rje'i gsung / 'on kyang phyi nang rten 'brel gnad/ da dung gzhan gyis shes pa med/ /glegs bam tsam la brten pa yi/ /lam 'bras pas kyang 'di mi shes/ /zhes pa drangs pa 'di/ gzhi dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i rig pa'i ye shes kho na nyams len gyi snying por 'dzin dgos kyi/ kun rdzob 'dus byas rten 'brel gyi chos la snying po med do/ /zhes 'dod pa'i sgrub byed du/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di gnad che zhing / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad glegs bam tsam la brten pa'i lam 'bras pas mi shes so gsungs pa bris pa ni rten 'brel la snying po med do zhes pa'i sgrub byed du/ rten 'brel gnad du che'o zhes pa drangs pa 'di brjod bya dang 'grig gam mi 'grig dpyad na rtogs sla'o/ /yang sa chen gyis/ rnam par rtog pa ye shes kyi/ /dbang du gyur na 'khor ba med/ /ces pa bskyed rim gyi sngon du lta ba ngo sprod pa'i tshig yin cing / 'di la myong ba thon nas gzod bskyed rim bsgom dgos par gsungs la lung 'di mthar thug gi rten 'brel bshad pa'i rgyab rten du drangs pa yang gnas skabs kyis mi 'grig pa yin no/

/der ma zad kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'di ma dag ring la sems nyid rnal ma'i don rtogs pa med do zhes dam bcas nas/ de'i rgyab rten du/ chos rje'i gsung / sems la ngo bo ma grub pas/ /sems kyi ngo sprod ga la yod/ /ces sogs mang po bris 'dug pa brjod bya dang 'grig dka' ste/ kun gzhi dag nas ye shes su gnas 'gyur mtshams sgom lam sa bcu gnyis pa'i rjes su gsungs 'dug pas/ sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la sems ngo 'phrod pa med do zhes ngas ni zhu mi spobs so/ /gzhan yang khong gis gzhi med kyi brdzun mang po bshad 'dug ste/ lta ba nyams myong dang yid byed kyis ma bslad par rig pa'i ye shes kyi rang ngo skyong ba las/ nyams len gzhan mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rje btsun gong ma lnga ka'i mtshan bris nas mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi gsung na gsal bar yod do zhes sogs mang po bris 'dug la /lugs 'di la nyams la skyon mi mdzad de/ rab dbye las/ 'on te bsgom pa'i nyams myong la/ /zer na tshogs lam chung ngu nas/ /mthar phyin lam gyi bar du yod/ /ces sogs gsungs la/ gzhan yang gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab na rig pa'i ye shes skyong ba las nyams len gzhan gtan nas mi dgos so zhes gsungs pa med do/ /de bzhin du/ sems gsal ba lam du byas na sems tsam pa yin zhes ngor chen gyis gsungs yod ces sogs brdzun mang po bris snang ngo / /khong gis bsam bzhin du lam 'bras kyi dgongs pa 'khyog po'i ngag gis gzhan du bshad pa yin pas/ dgag pa byed sa mang po 'dug rung / gong du bshad pa de tsam gyis khong gi bstan bcos snying po med par go nus pas re zhig bzhag go /gcam bu'i ngag gis gsung ngag don/ /gzhan du bshad pa'i bshad yams 'di/ /gzu bor gnas pas gnas pa'i don/ /gsal bar byas 'dis bsal 'di'o/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /lar deng dus dbang dang / rim gnyis/ dam tshig dang sdom pa sogs la 'bad rtsol chen po dgos so byas na rnam rtog lam du byed par song bas chos de mi zab snyam pa dang /

sgo gsum tha mal du bzhag nas spyod pa bag yangs su byed chog pa'i chos shig yod na shin tu zab par 'dug snyam pa mang rung / mnyam pa chen po'i ye shes kyis rgyud grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa la blang dor mi dgos kyang rtogs pa'i gdeng drod med bzhin du bag med kyi spyod pa la zhugs na/ rgyud las/ gal te de nyid med bzhin du/ /ngo mtshar che ba ltar byed pa/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar/ /shi ba'i 'og tu dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gro bas/ chos dang gang zag tha dad du ma song ba'i nyams len la brtson par bya ba ni gnad kyi don no/ /bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs pad bsten cing / khyad par du gsang bdag rdo rje snying po mi'i gzugs su byon pa 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po las/ dbang lung khrid gsum gyi rgyun da lta bzhugs pa phal cher nos shing / rgyal sras gzhan phan snang ba/ rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang grol/ chos rje bdag nyid chen po 'di gsum ka las kyang mdo sngags kyi chos mang du thos pas bla ma 'di bzhi gtso bo yin la/ thams cad grub thob yin pas yon tan gyi ngos nas bzang ngan med kyang / bka' drin gyi ngos nas tshe rabs las kyi 'brel ba mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gsol ba 'di nyid che ste/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa'i tshul gyis bsgoms pa'i nyams myong tsam med kyang bka' drin che ba'i rgyu mtshan rang gi nyams myong tshad mas grub pa yin no/ /don de yid la bzhag nas/ sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i mkhas grub kyi/ /bla ma mang pos rjes su bzung na yang / /sku drin gzhan dang mtshungs pa ma mchis pa/ /rje btsun thugs rje'i gter chen khyed lags so/ /de slad gang gi bka' drin dran pa'i tshe/

/mchi ma'i rgyun dang ngu ba'i smre ngag bcas/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis rgyang nas gsol 'debs pa/ /nyam thag byis pas pha ma 'bod pa 'dra/ /zhes rang nyid kyis sngar smras pa yin no/ /'o na khyod gsung ngag gi chos tshul 'di la phas rgol 'bum gyis 'phrog par mi nus pa'i yid ches yod tshul bris pa 'di nges par khyod la yod dam zhe na/ bshad par bya ste lam 'di'i gzhi bca' snang ba gsum gyis byed par snang la/ de bzhin byed tshe srid pa'i rtse mo man chad kyi 'khor ba'i gnas rnams sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin du thag chod pa'i bcos ma ma yin pa'i nges 'byung gis kun nas bslangs te/ byams snying rje dang / bden gnyis byang chub kyi sems sgom pa lam 'di'i nyams len yin zhing / khyad par don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul klu sgrub kyi byang chub sems 'grel la brten nas mdzad par 'dug pas 'di tshul bzhin du rgyud la 'byor na lam gyi gol sa zhen pa'i 'ching ba bzhi dang bral nas/ bdag med pa'i gnas lugs la nges pa rnyed nas/ stong rten 'byung 'gal med du nyams su len shes pa zhig 'byung ste/ de tsam byung na'ang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dal 'byor don yod byas pa ma yin nam/ deng sang mnyam pa chen pos rgyud grol ba'i rnal 'byor par khas len cing / gang zag gi bdag med bsgom mi shes pa re zung snang ba lam gyi gzhi bca' 'phyug pas lan pa yin nam snyam mo/ /dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi nyams len la/ lam gyi rtsa ba sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las tshul bzhin du thob nas/ de nas bsags sbyangs kyis rgyud sbyangs te lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med sgom par byed pa yin la/ 'di'i lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyis phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad la go ba legs po zhig rnyed tshe 'khor 'das phyi rol du 'dzin pa'i re dogs kyi spros pa chod nas/

rten 'brel thams cad nang nas skye bar shes/ de'i dus su skyon yon tan du slong shes shing / bar chad dngos grub tu len shes/ gcig shes pas mang po shes pa la sogs pa lam 'di'i che ba brjod pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs rnams 'di dang 'di lta bu yin par 'dug snyam du yid ches nang nas skye ba zhig 'byung bar gsungs so/ /de bzhin du 'khor 'das thun mong gi chos bdun gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len tshul sogs 'khor 'das bsre ba'i zab gnad rnams dang / kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor ba'i chos thams cad mtshan nyid kyi tshul dang / lam gyi chos yon tan gyi tshul dang / 'bras bu'i chos nus mthu'i tshul du tshang gsungs pa'i nyams len rgyud la sbyor shes tshe/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i nyams len sdom pa gsum la sogs pa thams cad sems rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du dril shes pa zhig 'byung ba yin la/ de ltar byung tshe/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rnams dang / de'i dgongs 'grel klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung rnams dang / bslab btus/ spyod 'jug byams chos lnga/ bsgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum sogs nas gsungs pa'i rgya chen spyod pa'i nyams len bslab pa gsum dang / rnam thar sgo gsum/ bden pa bzhi/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi shes rab/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dam pa gsum/ pha rol tu phyin pa re re la drug drug tshang ba sogs kyi nyams len thams cad rang gi nyams len la tshang bar rtogs shing / der ma zad rgyud sde bzhi'i nyams len thams cad tshang ba dang / dbang bzhi'i lam gyi zab gnad rnams dus gcig la sgom shes pa sogs 'byung la/ de'i dus su lam 'di lta bu dang 'phrad na 'bras bu'i chos thams cad nus mthu'i tshul du tshang tshul la'ang snying nas yid ches skyes te chos zab mo 'di'i sgo nas tshogs rdzogs pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs pa la dka' las ci yod/

chos gzhan yun du bsgom pa bas/ chos 'di'i nyams len thun gcig rang zab par 'dug snyam du mthong zhing / slob dpon ka ma la shī las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / rje btsun gong mas/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde ma lus pa'i don gyi bcud phyung ba gsungs pa de tshig tsam gyi che brjod min par go nas/ las ngan gyi rgya mtsho brdol ba'i blun po bdag lta bu la'ang mi 'phrog pa'i yid ches mi skye ba'i rang dbang ma byung ba lags so/ /slar smras pa/ bla ma'i thugs rje'i tsha zer gyis bran pas/ /rmongs pa'i sbubs chud bdag blo'i chu skyes kyang / /cung zad 'dzum pa'i skal pa mchog stsol ba/ /'dren mchog nyin byed dbang po gtsug na rgyal/ /gang gi zhabs pad gus pas legs bsten pas/ /gzhung bzang 'di la yid ches mi dman yang / /bsgom pa'i nyams myong da dung ma skyes pas/ /kyi hud bdag gi yid ni gdung bar gyur/ /'on kyang rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa'i/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gsang ba zla med pa/ /cha tsam rtogs nas phyogs tsam phyes pa la/ /nongs pa mchis na 'chos par mdzad du gsol/ /rab gus dad pa'i chu gter las 'ongs pa'i/ /legs bshad me tog gsar pa'i chun po 'di/ /rje btsun bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod sprin yin/ /thugs brtses bdag gir bzhes par mdzad du gsol/ /rnam dkar dge des tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun khyed kyi bran du skye ba dang / /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang 'di nyid la/ /nyan 'chad bsgom pa'i skal pa yod par shog /chos 'di'i zab gnad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /kun rmongs bdag gi spyod yul ma lags mod/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phyogs tsam mthong bas kyang / /mos gus spro ba dbyar mtsho'i rjes su song / /shin tu rgud pa'i dus ngan 'dir skyes kyang / /chos dang bla ma 'di 'drar 'phrad pa ni/

/sngon gyi legs byas skal pa mi dman pas/ /bdag gi yid la rab dga'i ngal gso thob/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa'i lam bzang 'di/ /sngon tshe shin tu dar bar gyur na yang / /da ni sa skya'i bstan pa nyams dmas pas/ /glegs bam tsam la gus par byed pa'ang nyung / /gang zhig rnyed na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i/ /zab chos rin thang med pa'i nor bu 'di/ /'byor ldan chen po'i phyag tu ma babs par/ /sprang po bdag gis skal pa'i dbang las rnyed/ /lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ /nyam chung ri sul nyul ba'i sprang po la/ /legs bshad yod mod srin bu'i 'od snang 'dis/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i go skabs dka'/ /gang zhig rtag tu dman pa'i sa bzung nas/ /zab don khong na nyal ba kun dga'i rnga/ /bla ma'i gsung gi dbyug gus bskul ba las/ /legs par bshad pa'i sgra 'di grags par gyur/ /mtshungs bral grub pa'i dbang phyug sa skya pa'i/ /dri med rang lugs gsung ngag gdams pa 'di/ /thub gsung mdo rgyud rgya mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i nor bu yin/ /de slad dam pa'i skyes bu mchog rnams kyi/ /rgyal tshab bstan pa'i khur chen khyer ba rnams/ /pha chos yid bzhin nor bu 'di blangs nas/ /don gnyer slob ma'i re ba skongs 'tshal lo/ /chos 'di mdo sngags gnyis kyi zab gnad kun/ /gang zag gcig gi nyams len mngon rtogs la/ /bsdus te sbyor ba'i man ngag yin pa'i phyir/ /'bad pa chung ngus 'di don rtogs par dka'/ /kye ho grogs dag brtson pa'i stobs bskyed la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam srol rma med pa'i/ /gzhung bzang 'di la gus par mdzod cig dang / /yang dag lam bzang khyed kyis rnyed par 'gyur/ /da ni mi tshe'i lhag ma ci yod la/ /rnam g.yengs spangs te gcig tu nyams len la/ /brtson pa'i skal bzang myur du 'byung bar ni/ /pha gcig bla mas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/
